translations.translation: allAha ke nAma se jo rahamAna va rahIma hai|
tArIfa allAha hI ke liye hai jo tamAma qAyanAta kA raba hai|
rahamAna aura rahIma hai|
roz2e jaz2A kA mAlika hai|
hama terI hI ibAdata karate haiM, aura tujha hI se madada mAMgate hai|
hameM sIdhA rAstA dikhA|
una logoM kA rAstA jina para tUne inAma faramAyA, jo mAatUba nahIM hue, jo bhaTake hue nahIM hai|
alIfa lAma mIma
(ye) vaha kitAba hai| jisa (ke kitAbe khudA hone) meM kucha bhI zaka nahIM (ye) parahez2agAroM kI rahanumA hai
jo g2aiba para ImAna lAte haiM aura (pAbandI se) namAz2a adA karate haiM aura jo kucha hamane unako diyA hai usameM se (rAhe khudA meM) qharca karate haiM
aura jo kucha tuma para (ai rasUla) aura tuma se pahale nAz2ila kiyA gayA hai usa para ImAna lAte haiM aura vahI Aqhirata kA yaqIna bhI rakhate haiM
yahI loga apane paravaradigAra kI hidAyata para (Amila) haiM aura yahI loga apanI dilI murAdeM pAe~ge
bezaka jina logoM ne kufra iqhateyAra kiyA unake lie barAbara hai (ai rasUla) khvAha (cAhe) tuma unheM DarAo yA na DarAo vaha ImAna na lAe~ge
unake diloM para aura unake kAnoM para (naz2ara karake) khudA ne tasadIqa kara dI hai (ki ye ImAna na lAe~ge) aura unakI ऑMkhoM para paradA (par3A huA) hai aura unhIM ke lie (bahuta) bar3A az2Aba hai
aura bAz2a loga aise bhI haiM jo (z2abAna se to) kahate haiM ki hama khudA para aura qayAmata para ImAna lAe hAlA~ki vaha dila se ImAna nahIM lAe
khudA ko aura una logoM ko jo ImAna lAe dhokhA dete haiM hAlA~ki vaha apane Apako dhokhA dete haiM aura kucha zaUra nahIM rakhate haiM
unake diloM meM marz2a thA hI aba khudA ne unake marz2a ko aura baढ़A diyA aura cU~ki vaha loga jhUTha bolA karate the isalie una para takalIpha deha az2Aba hai
aura jaba unase kahA jAtA hai ki mulka meM phasAda na karate phiro (to) kahate haiM ki hama to sirpha isalAha karate haiM
qhabaradAra ho jAo bezaka yahI loga phasAdI haiM lekina samajhate nahIM

aura jaba unase kahA jAtA hai ki jisa taraha aura loga ImAna lAe haiM tuma bhI ImAna lAo to kahate haiM kyA hama bhI usI taraha ImAna lAe~ jisa taraha aura bevakUfa loga ImAna lAe~, qhabaradAra ho jAo loga bevaqUfa haiM lekina nahIM jAnate

aura jaba una logoM se milate haiM jo ImAna lA cuke to kahate haiM hama to ImAna lA cuke aura jaba apane zaitAnoM ke sAtha tanahA raha jAte haiM to kahate haiM hama tumhAre sAtha haiM hama to (musalamAnoM ko) banAte haiM
(vaha kyA banAe~ge) khudA unako banAtA hai aura unako DhIla detA hai ki vaha apanI sarakazI meM g2alata pecA~ (ulajhe) raheM
yahI vaha loga haiM jinhoMne hidAyata ke badale gumarAhI qharIda lI, phira na unakI tijArata hI ne kucha nafA diyA aura na una logoM ne hidAyata hI pAI

una logoM kI misAla (to) usa zakhsa kI sI hai jisane (rAta ke vakta majame meM) bhar3akatI huIAga rauzana kI phira jaba Aga (ke zole) ne usake girdoM peza (cAroM ora) khUba ujAlA kara diyA to khudA ne unakI rauzanI le lI aura unako ghaTATopa aMdhere meM chor3a diyA
ki aba unheM kucha sujhAI nahIM detA ye loga bahare gU~ge andhe haiM ki phira apanI gumarAhI se bAz2a nahIM A sakate

yA unakI misAla aisI hai jaise AsamAnI bAriza jisameM tArikiyA~ g2arz2a bijalI ho mauta ke khaupha se kar3aka ke mAre apane kAnoM meM U~galiyA~ de lete haiM hAlA~ki khudA kAfiroM ko (isa taraha) ghere hue hai (ki usaka hila nahIM sakate)

qarIba hai ki bijalI unakI ऑMkhoM ko caundhiyA de jaba unake Age bijalI camakI to usa rauzanI meM cala khar3e hue aura jaba una para aMdherA chA gayA to (ThiThake ke) khar3e ho gae aura khudA cAhatA to yU~ bhI unake dekhane aura sunane kI kUvateM chIna letA bezaka khudA hara cIz2a para qAdira hai
ai logoM apane paravaradigAra kI ibAdata karo jisane tumako aura una logoM ko jo tuma se pahale the paidA kiyA hai ajaba nahIM tuma parahez2agAra bana jAo

jisane tumhAre lie z2amIna kA bichaunA aura AsamAna ko chata banAyA aura AsamAna se pAnI barasAyA phira usI ne tumhAre khAne ke lie bAz2a phala paidA kie pasa kisI ko khudA kA hamasara na banAo hAlA~ki tuma khUba jAnate ho

aura agara tuma loga isa kalAma se jo hamane apane bande (mohammada) para nAz2ila kiyA hai zaka meM par3e ho pasa agara tuma sacce ho to tuma (bhI) eka sUrA banA lAo aura khudA ke sivA jo bhI tumhAre madadagAra hoM unako bhI bulA lo
pasa agara tuma ye nahIM kara sakate ho aura haragiz2a nahIM kara sakoge to usa Aga se Daro sike Idhana AdamI aura patthara hoMge aura kAfiroM ke lie taiyAra kI gaI hai

aura jo loga ImAna lAe aura unhoMne neka kAma kie unako (ai paig2ambara) khuzaqhabarI de do ki unake lie (behizta ke) vaha bAg2Ata haiM jinake nIce nahare jArI haiM jaba unheM ina bAg2Ata kA koI mevA khAne ko milegA to kaheMge ye to vahI (mevA hai jo pahale bhI hameM khAne ko mila cukA hai) (kyoMki) unheM milatI julatI sUrata va raMga ke (meve) milA kareMge aura behizta meM unake lie sApha sutharI bIviyA~ hogI aura ye loga usa bAg2a meM hamezA raheMge

bezaka khudA macchara yA usase bhI baढ़kara (haqIra cIz2a) kI koI misAla bayAna karane meM nahIM jheMpatA pasa jo loga ImAna lA cuke haiM vaha to ye yaqIna jAnate haiM ki ye (misAla) bilkula ThIka hai aura ye paravaradigAra kI tarafa se hai (aba rahe) vaha loga jo kAfira hai pasa vaha bola uThate haiM ki khudA kA usa misAla se kyA matalaba hai, aisI misAla se qhudA bahuteroM kI hidAyata karatA hai magara gumarAhI meM chor3atA bhI hai to aise badakAroM ko

jo loga khudA ke ehado paimAna ko maz2abUta ho jAne ke bAda tor3a DAlate haiM aura jina (tAlluqAta) kA khudA ne hukma diyA hai unako qatAA kara dete haiM aura mulka meM phasAda karate phirate haiM, yahI loga ghATA uThAne vAle haiM

(hA~e) kyoM kara tuma khudA kA inkAra kara sakate ho hAlA~ki tuma (mAoM ke peTa meM) bejAna the to usI ne tumako z2indA kiyA phira vahI tumako mAra DAlegA, phira vahI tumako (dobArA qayAmata meM) z2indA karegA phira usI kI tarapha lauTAe jAoge

vahI to vaha (khudA) hai jisane tumhAre (nafe) ke z2amIna kI kula cIz2oM ko paidA kiyA phira AsamAna (ke banAne) kI tarafa mutAvajjeha huA to sAta AsamAna hamavAra (va musatahakama) banA die aura vaha (khudA) hara cIz2a se (khUba) vAqipha hai

aura (ai rasUla) usa vakta qo yAda karo jaba tumhAre paravaradigAra ne fariztoM se kahA ki maiM (apanA) eka nAeba z2amIna meM banAnevAlA hU~ (pharizte tAjjuba se) kahane lage kyA tU z2amIna aise zakhsa ko paidA karegA jo z2amIna meM fasAda aura khU~rez2iyA~ karatA phire hAlA~ki (agara) qhalIphA banAnA hai (to hamArA jyAdA haqa hai) kyoMki hama terI tArIpha va tasabIha karate haiM aura terI pAkIz2agI sAbita karate haiM taba khudA ne pharamAyA isameM to zaka hI nahIM ki jo maiM jAnatA hU~ tuma nahIM jAnate

aura (Adama kI haqIqama z2Ahira karane kI g2araz2a se) Adama ko saba cIz2oM ke nAma sikhA die phira unako phariztoM ke sAmane peza kiyA aura faramAyA ki agara tuma apane dAve meM ki hama mustahake qhilAfata haiM| sacce ho to mujhe ina cIz2oM ke nAma batAo
taba fariztoM ne (Ajiz2I se) arz2a kI tU (hara aiba se) pAka va pAkIz2A hai hama to jo kucha tUne batAyA hai usake sivA kucha nahIM jAnate tU bar3A jAnane vAlA, masalahatoM kA pahacAnane vAlA hai

(usa vakta qhudA ne Adama ko) hukma diyA ki ai Adama tuma ina fariztoM ko una saba cIz2oM ke nAma batA do basa jaba Adama ne fariztoM ko una cIz2oM ke nAma batA die to khudA ne phariztoM kI tarapha qhitAba karake pharamAyA kyoM, maiM tumase na kahatA thA ki maiM AsamAnoM aura z2amInoM ke chipe hue rAz2a ko jAnatA hU~, aura jo kucha tuma aba z2Ahira karate ho aura jo kucha tuma chipAte the (vaha saba) jAnatA hU~
aura (usa vakta qo yAda karo) jaba hamane fariztoM se kahA ki Adama ko sajadA karo to saba ke saba jhuka gae magara zaitAna ne inkAra kiyA aura g2urUra meM A gayA aura kAfira ho gayA

aura hamane Adama se kahA ai Adama tuma apanI bIvI samaita behizta meM rahA sahA karo aura jahA~ se tumhArA jI cAhe usameM se ba pharAg2ata khAo (piyo) magara usa darakhta ke pAsa bhI na jAnA (varanA) phira tuma apanA Apa nuqasAna karoge

taba zaitAna ne Adama va hauvvA ko (dhokhA dekara) vahA~ se DagamagAyA aura Aqhira kAra unako jisa (aiza va rAhata) meM the unase nikAla pheMkA aura hamane kahA (ai Adama va hauvvA) tuma (z2amIna para) utara par3o tumameM se eka kA eka duzamana hogA aura z2amIna meM tumhAre lie eka qhAsa vakta (qayAmata) taka ThaharAva aura ThikAnA hai
phira Adama ne apane paravaradigAra se (mAz2arata ke canda alphAz2a) sIkhe pasa khudA ne una alphAz2a kI barakata se Adama kI taubA kubUla kara lI bezaka vaha bar3A mAfa karane vAlA meharabAna hai

(aura jaba Adama ko) ye hukma diyA thA ki yahA~ se utara par3o (to bhI kaha diyA thA ki) agara tumhAre pAsa merI tarafa se hidAyata Ae to (usakI pairavI karanA kyoMki) jo loga merI hidAyata para caleMge una para (qayAmata) meM na koI qhaupha hogA
aura na vaha raMjIdA hoge aura (ye bhI yAda rakho) jina logoM ne kuphra iqhateyAra kiyA aura hamArI AyatoM ko jhuThalAyA to vahI jahannumI haiM aura hamezA doz2aqha meM par3e rahege

ai banI isarAIla (yAqUba kI aulAda) mere una ehasAnAta ko yAda karo jo tuma para pahale kara cuke haiM aura tuma mere ehada va iqarAra (ImAna) ko pUrA karo to maiM tumhAre ehada (savAba) ko pUrA karU~gA, aura mujha hI se Darate raho

aura jo (kurAna) maiMne nAz2ila kiyA vaha usa kitAba (taureta) kI (bhI) tasadIqa karatA hU~ jo tumhAre pAsa hai aura tuma sabase cale usake inkAra para maujUda na ho jAo aura merI AyatoM ke badale thor3I qImata (dunayAvI phAyadA) na lo aura mujha hI se Darate raho
aura haqa ko bAtila ke sAtha na milAo aura haqa bAta ko na chipAo hAlA~ki tuma jAnate ho aura pAbandI se namAz2a adA karo
aura z2akAta diyA karo aura jo loga (hamAre sAmane) ibAdata ke lie jhukate haiM unake sAtha tuma bhI jhukA karo
aura tuma logoM se nekI karane ko kahate ho aura apanI qhabara nahIM lete hAlA~ki tuma kitAbe khudA ko (barAbara) raTA karate ho to tuma kyA itanA bhI nahIM samajhate
aura (musIbata ke vakta) sabra aura namAz2a kA sahArA pakar3o aura alabattA namAz2a dUbhara to hai magara una qhAqasAroM para (nahIM) jo baqhUbI jAnate haiM
ki vaha apane paravaradigAra kI bAragAha meM hAz2ira hoMge aura z2arUra usakI tarapha lauTa jAe~ge
ai banI isarAila merI una neamatoM ko yAda karo jo maiMne pahale tumheM dI aura ye (bhI to soco) ki hamane tumako sAre jahAna ke logoM se baढ़A diyA

aura usa dina se Daro (jisa dina) koI zakhsa kisI kI tarapha se na phidiyA ho sakegA aura na usakI tarapha se koI siphAriza mAnI jAegI aura na usakA koI muAvaz2A liyA jAegA aura na vaha madada pahu~cAe jAe~ge

aura (usa vakta qo yAda karo) jaba hamane tumheM (tumhAre burz2ago ko) phiraauna (ke panje) se chur3AyA jo tumheM bar3e-bar3e dukha de ke satAte the tumhAre lar3akoM para churI pherate the aura tumhArI auratoM ko (apanI qhidamata ke lie) z2indA rahane dete the aura usameM tumhAre paravaradigAra kI tarapha se (tumhAre sabra kI) sakhta Az2amAiza thI
aura (vaha vakta bhI yAda karo) jaba hamane tumhAre lie dariyA ko Tukar3e-Tukar3e kiyA phira hamane tumako chuTakArA diyA aura phiraauna ke AdamiyoM ko tumhAre dekhate-dekhate Dubo diyA aura
(vaha vakta bhI yAda karo) jaba hamane mUsA se cAlIsa rAtoM kA vAyadA kiyA thA aura tuma logoM ne unake jAne ke bAda eka bachar3e ko (parasatiza ke lie khudA) banA liyA
hAlA~ki tuma apane Upara z2ulma jota rahe the phira hamane usake bAda bhI daraguz2ara kI tAki tuma zukra karo
aura (vaha vakta bhI yAda karo) jaba mUsA ko (taureta) atA kI aura haqa aura bAtila ko judA karanevAlA qAnUna (inAyata kiyA) tAke tuma hidAyata pAo

aura (vaha vakta bhI yAda karo) jaba mUsA ne apanI qauma se kahA ki ai merI qauma tumane bachar3e ko (qhudA) banA ke apane Upara bar3A sakhta julma kiyA to aba (isake sivA koI cArA nahIM ki) tuma apane qhAlika kI bAragAha meM taubA karo aura vaha ye hai ki apane ko qatla kara DAlo tumhAre paravaradigAra ke naz2adIka tumhAre haqa meM yahI behatara hai, phira jaba tumane aisA kiyA to khudA ne tumhArI taubA qubUla kara lI bezaka vaha bar3A meharabAna mAfa karane vAlA hai

aura (vaha vakta bhI yAda karo) jaba tumane mUsA se kahA thA ki ai mUsA hama tuma para usa vakta taka ImAna na lAe~ge jaba taka hama khudA ko z2Ahira baz2Ahira na dekha le usa para tumheM bijalI ne le DAlA, aura tuma takate hI raha gae
phira tumheM tumhAre marane ke bAda hamane jilA uThAyA tAki tuma zukra karo

aura hamane tuma para abra kA sAyA kiyA aura tuma para mana va salavA utArA aura (ye bhI to kaha diyA thA ki) jo sutharI va naphIsa roz2iyA tumheM dI haiM unheM zauqa se khAo, aura una logoM ne hamArA to kucha bigar3A nahIM magara apanI jAnoM para sitama DhAte rahe

aura (vaha vakta bhI yAda karo) jaba hamane tumase kahA ki isa gA~va (arIhA) meM jAo aura isameM jahA~ cAho pharAg2ata se khAo (piyo) aura daravAz2e para sajadA karate hue aura z2abAna se hittA bakhziza kahate hue Ao to hama tumhArI qhatA ye bakhza dege aura hama nekI karane vAloM kI nekI (savAba) baढ़A degeM
to jo bAta unase kahI gaI thI use zarIroM ne badalakara dUsarI bAta kahanI zurU kara dI taba hamane una logoM para jinhoMne zarArata kI thI unakI badakArI kI vajaha se AsamAnI balA nAz2ila kI

aura (vaha vakta bhI yAda karo) jaba mUsA ne apanI qauma ke lie pAnI mA~gA to hamane kahA (ai mUsA) apanI lAThI patthara para mAro (lAThI mArate hI) usameM se bAraha cazmeM phUTa nikale aura saba logoM ne apanA-apanA ghATa bakhUbI jAna liyA aura hamane Ama ijAz2ata de dI ki khudA kI dI huIroz2I se khAo piyo aura mulka meM phasAda na karate phiro

(aura vaha vakta bhI yAda karo) jaba tumane mUsA se kahA ki ai mUsA hamase eka hI khAne para na rahA jAegA to Apa hamAre lie apane paravaradigAra se duA kIjie ki jo cIz2e z2amIna se ugatI hai jaise sAga pAta tarakArI aura kakar3I aura gehU~ yA (lahasuna) aura masUra aura pyAz2a (mana va salavA) kI jagaha paidA kareM (mUsA ne) kahA kyA tuma aisI cIz2a ko jo hara taraha se behatara hai adanA cIz2a se badalana cAhate ho to kisI zahara meM utara par3o phira tumhAre lie jo tumane mA~gA hai saba maujUda hai aura una para rUsavAI aura mohatAjI kI mAra par3I aura una logoM ne qahare khudA kI tarapha palaTA khAyA, ye saba isa sababa se huA ki vaha loga khudA kI nizAniyoM se inkAra karate the aura paig2ambaroM ko nAhaka zahIda karate the, aura isa vajaha se (bhI) ki vaha nAfaramAnI aura sarakazI kiyA karate the

bezaka musalamAnoM aura yahUdiyoM aura nasarAniyoM aura lA maz2ahaboM meM se jo koI khudA aura roz2e Aqhirata para ImAna lAe aura acche-acche kAma karatA rahe to unhIM ke lie unakA ajra va savAba unake khudA ke pAsa hai aura na (qayAmata meM) una para kisI kA qhaupha hogA na vaha raMjIdA dila hoMge

aura (vaha vakta yAda karo) jaba hamane (tAmIle taureta) kA tumase eqarAra kara liyA aura hamane tumhAre sara para tUra se (pahAr3a ko) lAkara laTakAyA aura kaha diyA ki taureta jo hamane tumako dI hai usako maz2abUta pakar3e raho aura jo kucha usameM hai usako yAda rakho
tAki tuma parahez2agAra bano phira usake bAda tuma (apane ehado paimAna se) phira gae pasa agara tuma para khudA kA phaz2ala aura usakI meharabAnI na hotI to tumane sakhta ghATA uThAyA hotA

aura apanI qauma se una logoM kI hAlata to tuma bakhUbI jAnate ho jo zambe (sanIcara) ke dina apanI hada se guz2ara gae (ki bAvajUda mumAniata zikAra khelane nikale) to hamane una se kahA ki tuma rAinde gae bandara bana jAo (aura vaha bandara ho gae)
pasa hamane isa vAqaye se una logoM ke vAste jina ke sAmane huA thA aura jo usake bAda AnevAle the az2Aba qarAra diyA, aura parahez2agAroM ke lie nasIhata

aura (vaha vakta yAda karo) jaba mUsA ne apanI qauma se kahA ki khudA tuma logoM ko tAkIdI hukma karatA hai ki tuma eka gAya z2ibAha karo vaha loga kahane lage kyA tuma hamase dillagI karate ho mUsA ne kahA maiM khudA se panAha mA~gatA hU~ ki maiM jAhila banU~

(taba vaha loga kahane lage ki (acchA) tuma apane khudA se duA karo ki hameM batA de ki vaha gAya kaisI ho mUsA ne kahA bezaka khudA ne pharamAtA hai ki vaha gAya na to bahuta bUढ़I ho aura na bachiyA balki unameM se ausata daraje kI ho, g2araz2a jo tumako hukma diyA gayA usako bajA lAo

vaha kahane lage (vAha) tuma apane khudA se duA karo ki hameM ye batA de ki usakA raMga Aqhira kyA ho mUsA ne kahA bezaka khudA pharamAtA hai ki vaha gAya khUba gahare z2arda raMga kI ho dekhane vAle use dekhakara khuza ho jAe

taba kahane lage ki tuma apane khudA se duA karo ki hameM z2arA ye to batA de ki vaha (gAya) aura kaisI ho (vaha) gAya to aura gAyoM meM mila jula gaI aura khudA ne cAhA to hama z2arUra (usakA) patA lagA lege

mUsA ne kahA khudA z2arUra pharamAtA hai ki vaha gAya na to itanI sadhAI ho ki z2amIna jote na khetI sIceM bhalI caMgI eka raMga kI ki usameM koI dhabbA taka na ho, vaha bole aba (jA ke) ThIka-ThIka bayAna kiyA, g2araz2a una logoM ne vaha gAya halAla kI hAlA~ki unase ummIda na thI vaha ki vaha aisA kareMge
aura jaba eka zakhsa ko mAra DAlA aura tumameM usakI bAbata phUTa par3a gaI eka dUsare ko qAtila batAne lagA jo tuma chipAte the

khudA ko usakA z2Ahira karanA maMjUra thA pasa hamane kahA ki usa gAya ko koI Tukar3A lekara isa (kI lAza) para mAro yU~ khudA murde ko z2indA karatA hai aura tuma ko apanI kudarata kI nizAniyA~ dikhA detA hai

tAki tuma samajho phira usake bAda tumhAre dila sakhta ho gaye pasa vaha misala patthara ke (sakhta) the yA usase bhI jyAdA karakhta kyoMki pattharoM meM bAz2a to aise hote haiM ki unase nahareM jArI ho jAtI haiM aura bAz2a aise hote haiM ki unameM darAra par3a jAtI hai aura unameM se pAnI nikala par3atA hai aura bAz2a patthara to aise hote haiM ki khudA ke qhaupha se gira par3ate haiM aura jo kucha tuma kara rahe ho usase khudA g2Aphila nahIM hai

(musalamAnoM) kyA tuma ye lAlaca rakhate ho ki vaha tumhArA (sA) ImAna lAe~geM hAlA~ki unameM kA eka giroha (sAbiqa meM) aisA thA ki khudA kA kalAma sunAtA thA aura acchI taraha samajhane ke bAda ulaTa phera kara detA thA hAlA~ki vaha khUba jAnate the aura jaba una logoM se mulAqAta karate haiM

aura jina logoM ne kufra ikhtiyAra kiyA vaha haragiz2a ye na khyAla kareM ki hamane jo unako mohalata va bephikrI de rakhI hai vaha unake haqa meM behatara hai (hAlaॉki) hamane mohallata va bephikrI sirpha isa vajaha se dI hai tAki vaha aura qhUba gunAha kara leM aura (Aqhira to) unake lie rUsavA karane vAlA az2Aba hai

(munAfiqo) qhudA aisA nahIM ki bure bhale kI tamIz2a kie bagaira jisa hAlata para tuma ho usI hAlata para mominoM ko bhI chor3a de aura qhudA aisA bhI nahIM hai ki tumheM gaiba kI bAteM batA de magara (haॉ) qhudA apane rasUloM meM jise cAhatA hai (gaiba batAne ke vAste) cuna letA hai pasa qhudA aura usake rasUloM para ImAna lAo aura agara tuma ImAna lAoge aura parahez2agArI karoge to tumhAre vAste bar3I jaz2Ae qhaira hai

aura jina logoM ko qhudA ne apane faz2ala (va karama) se kucha diyA hai (aura phira) bukhla karate haiM vaha haragiz2a isa khyAla meM na raheM ki ye unake lie (kucha) behatara hogA balki ye unake haqa meM badatara hai kyoMki jisa (mAla) kA bukhla karate haiM anaqarIba hI qayAmata ke dina usakA tauqa banAkara unake gale meM pahanAyA jAegA aura sAre AsamAna va z2amIna kI mIrAsa qhudA hI kI hai aura jo kucha tuma karate ho qhudA usase qhabaradAra hai

jo loga (yahUda) ye kahate haiM ki qhudA to kaMgAla hai aura hama bar3e mAladAra haiM qhudA ne unakI ye bakavAsa sunI una logoM ne jo kucha kiyA usako aura unakA paig2ambaroM ko nAhaqa qatla karanA hama abhI se likha lete haiM aura (Aja to jo jI meM kaheM magara qayAmata ke dina) hama kaheMge ki acchA to lo (apanI zarArata ke evaz2a meM) jalAne vAle az2Aba kA maz2A cakho
ye unhIM kAmoM kA badalA hai jinako tumhAre hAthoM ne (z2Ade Aqherata banA kara) pahale se bhejA hai varanA qhudA to kabhI apane bandoM para z2ulma karane vAlA nahIM

(yaha vahI loga haiM) jo kahate haiM ki qhudA ne to hamase vAyadA kiyA hai ki jaba taka koI rasUla hameM ye (maujiz2A) na dikhA de ki vaha kurabAnI kare aura usako (AsamAnI) Aga Akara caTa kara jAe usa vakta taka hama ImAna na lAeMgeM (ai rasUla) tuma kaha do ki (bhalA) ye to batAo bahutere paig2ambara mujhase qabla tumhAre pAsa vAje va rauzana maujiz2Ata aura jisa cIz2a kI tumane (usa vakta) faramAiza kI hai (vaha bhI) lekara Ae phira tuma agara (apane dAve meM) sacce to tumane kyoM qatla kiyA

(ai rasUla) agara vaha isa para bhI tumheM jhuThalAeM to (tuma Az2urdA na ho kyoMki) tumase pahale bhI bahuta se paig2ambara rauzana maujiz2e aura sahIphe aura nUrAnI kitAba lekara A cuke haiM (magara) phira bhI logoM ne Aqhira jhuThalA hI chor3A

hara jAna eka na eka (dina) mauta kA maz2A cakhegI aura tuma loga qayAmata ke dina (apane kie kA) pUrA pUrA badalA bhara pAoge pasa jo zakhsa jahannuma se haTA diyA gayA aura bahizta meM pahuMcA diyA gayA pasa vahI kAmayAba huA aura duniyA kI (canda roz2A) z2indagI dhokhe kI TaTTI ke sivA kucha nahIM

(musalamAnoM) tumhAre mAloM aura jAnoM kA tumase z2arUra imtehAna liyA jAegA aura jina logo ko tuma se pahale kitAbe qhudA dI jA cukI hai (yahUda va nasArA) unase aura muzarekIna se bahuta hI dukha darda kI bAteM tumheM z2arUra sunanI par3eMgI aura agara tuma (una musIbatoM ko) jhela jAoge aura parahez2agArI karate rahoge to bezaka ye bar3I himmata kA kAma hai

aura (ai rasUla) inako vaha vakta to yAda dilAo jaba qhudA ne ahale kitAba se ehada va paimAna liyA thA ki tuma kitAbe qhudA ko sAfa sAfa bayAna kara denA aura (qhabaradAra) usakI koI bAta chupAnA nahIM magara ina logoM ne (z2arA bhI khyAla na kiyA) aura unako pase puzta pheMka diyA aura usake badale meM (basa) thor3I sI qImata hAsila kara lI pasa ye kyA hI burA (saudA) hai jo ye loga qharIda rahe haiM

(ai rasUla) tuma unheM khyAla meM bhI na lAnA jo apanI kArastAnI para itarAe jAte haiM aura kiyA karAyA qhAka nahIM (magara) tArIfa ke qhAstagAra (cAhate) haiM pasa tuma haragiz2a ye khyAla na karanA ki inako az2Aba se chuTakArA hai balki unake lie dardanAka az2Aba hai
aura AsamAna va z2amIna saba qhudA hI kA mulka hai aura qhudA hI hara cIz2a para qAdira hai
isameM to zaka hI nahIM ki AsamAnoM aura z2amIna kI paidAiza aura rAta dina ke phera badala meM aklamandoM ke lie (qudarata qhudA kI) bahuta sI nizAniyaॉ haiM

jo loga uThate baiThate karavaTa lete (alagaraz2a hara hAla meM) qhudA kA z2ikra karate haiM aura AsamAnoM aura z2amIna kI banAvaTa meM g2aura va fikra karate haiM aura (besAkhtA) kaha uThate haiM ki qhudAvandA tUne isako bekAra paidA nahIM kiyA tU (phele abasa se) pAka va pAkIz2A hai basa hamako doz2aka ke az2Aba se bacA
ai hamAre pAlane vAle jisako tUne doz2aqha meM DAlA to yaqInana use rUsavA kara DAlA aura julma karane vAle kA koI madadagAra nahIM

ai hamAre pAlane vAle (jaba) hamane eka AvAz2a lagAne vAle (paig2ambara) ko sunA ki vaha (ImAna ke vAste yUM pukAratA thA) ki apane paravaradigAra para ImAna lAo to hama ImAna lAe pasa ai hamAre pAlane vAle hameM hamAre gunAha bakhza de aura hamArI burAIyoM ko hamase dUra kare de aura hameM nekoM ke sAtha (duniyA se) uThA le
aura ai pAlane vAle apane rasUloM kI mArphata jo kucha hamase vAyadA kiyA hai hameM de aura hameM qayAmata ke dina rUsavA na kara tU to vAyadA qhilAfI karatA hI nahIM

to unake paravaradigAra ne duA kubUla kara lI aura (faramAyA) ki hama tumameM se kisI kAma karane vAle ke kAma ko akArata nahIM karate marda ho yA aurata (usa meM kucha kisI kI khusUsiyata nahIM kyoMki) tuma eka dUsare (kI jinsa) se ho jo loga (hamAre lie vatana AvArA hue) aura zahara badara kie gae aura unhoMne hamArI rAha meM az2IyateM uThAyIM aura (kuphfara se) jaMga kI aura zahIda hue maiM unakI burAIyoM se z2arUra daraguz2ara karUMgA aura unheM behizta ke una bAg2oM meM le jAUॅgA jinake nIce nahareM jArI haiM qhudA ke yahaॉ ye unake kiye kA badalA hai aura qhudA (aisA hI hai ki usa) ke yahaॉ to acchA hI badalA hai
(ai rasUla) kAfiroM kA zaharoM zaharoM caina karate phiranA tumhe dhokhe meM na DAle
ye canda roz2A fAyadA haiM phira to (AqhirakAra) unakA ThikAnA jahannuma hI hai aura kyA hI burA ThikAnA hai

magara jina logoM ne apane paravaradigAra kI parahez2agArI (ikhteyAra kI unake lie behizta ke) vaha bAg2Ata haiM jinake nIce nahareM jArIM haiM aura vaha hamezA usI meM raheMge ye qhudA kI tarafa se unakI (dAvata hai aura jo sAz2o sAmAna) qhudA ke yahaॉ hai vaha neko kAroM ke vAste duniyA se kahIM behatara hai

aura ahale kitAba meM se kucha loga to aise z2arUra haiM jo qhudA para aura jo (kitAba) tuma para nAz2ila huI aura jo (kitAba) unapara nAz2ila huI (saba para) ImAna rakhate haiM qhudA ke Age sara jhukAe hue haiM aura qhudA kI AyatoM ke badale thor3I sI qImata (duniyAvI fAyade) nahIM lete aise hI logoM ke vAste unake paravaradigAra ke yahaॉ acchA badalA hai bezaka qhudA bahuta jalda hisAba karane vAlA hai
ai ImAnadAroM (dIna kI takalIfoM ko) aura dUsaroM ko bardAzta kI tAlIma do aura (jihAda ke lie) kamareM kasa lo aura qhudA hI se Daro tAki tuma apanI dilI murAda pAo

ai logoM apane pAlane vAle se Daro jisane tuma sabako (sirpha) eka zakhsa se paidA kiyA aura (vaha isa taraha ki pahale) unakI bAkI miTTI se unakI bIvI (havvA) ko paidA kiyA aura (sirfa) unhIM do (miyaॉ bIvI) se bahuta se marda aura aurateM duniyA meM phailA diye aura usa qhudA se Daro jisake vasIle se Apasa meM eka dUsare se savAla karate ho aura qatae rahama se bhI Daro bezaka qhudA tumhArI dekhabhAla karane vAlA hai
aura yatImoM ko unake mAla de do aura burI cIz2a (mAle harAma) ko bhalI cIz2a (mAle halAla) ke badale meM na lo aura unake mAla apane mAloM meM milAkara na cakha jAo kyoMki ye bahuta bar3A gunAha hai

aura agara tumako andezA ho ki (nikAha karake) tuma yatIma lar3akiyoM (kI rakharakhAva) meM insApha na kara sakoge to aura auratoM meM apanI marz2I ke mavAfika do do aura tIna tIna aura cAra cAra nikAha karo (phira agara tumheM isakA) andezA ho ki (mutataida) bIviyoM meM (bhI) insApha na kara sakoge to eka hI para iktefA karo yA jo (loMDI) tumhArI z2ara qharIda ho (usI para qanAata karo) ye tadabIra beinsAfI na karane kI bahuta qarIne qayAsa hai
aura auratoM ko unake mahara qhuzI qhuzI de DAlo phira agara vaha qhuzI qhuzI tumheM kucha chor3a de to zauqa se nauze jAna khAo piyo

aura apane vaha mAla jinapara qhudA ne tumhArI guz2ara na qarAra dI hai bevakUfoM (nA samajha yatIma) ko na de baiTho haॉ usameM se unheM khilAo aura unako pahanAo (to maz2AeqA nahIM) aura unase (zauqa se) acchI taraha bAta karo

aura yatImoM ko kArobAra meM lagAe raho yahaॉ taka ke byAhane ke qAbila hoM phira usa vakta tuma unhe (eka mahIne kA qharca) unake hAtha se karAke agara hoziyAra pAo to unakA mAla unake havAle kara do aura (qhabaradAra) aisA na karanA ki isa qhaufa se ki kahIM ye bar3e ho jAeMge fuz2Ula qharcI karake jhaTapaTa unakA mAla caTa kara jAo aura jo (jo valI yA saraparasta) daulatamanda ho to vaha (mAle yatIma apane qharca meM lAne se) bacatA rahe aura (haॉ) jo mohatAja ho vaha alabattA (vAjibI) dastUra ke mutAbiqa khA sakatA hai pasa jaba unake mAla unake havAle karane lago to logoM ko unakA gavAha banA lo aura (yUM to) hisAba lene ko qhudA kAfI hI hai

maॉ bApa aura qarAbatadAroM ke tarke meM kucha hissA qhAsa mardoM kA hai aura usI taraha mA~ bAba aura qarAbatadAro ke tarake meM kucha hissA qhAsa auratoM kA bhI hai khvAha tarka kama ho yA jyAdA (hara zakhsa kA) hissA (hamArI tarafa se) muqarrara kiyA huA hai

aura jaba (tarka kI) taqasIma ke vakta (vaha) qarAbatadAra (jinakA koI hissA nahIM) aura yatIma bacce aura mohatAja loga A jAeM to unhe bhI kucha usameM se de do aura use acchI taraha (unavAne zAistA se) bAta karo

aura una logoM ko DaranA (aura khyAla karanA cAhiye) ki agara vaha loga qhuda apane bAda (nanhe nanhe) nAtavaॉ bacce chor3a jAte to una para (kisa qadara) tarasa AtA pasa unako (g2arIba baccoM para sakhtI karane meM) qhudA se DaranA cAhiye aura unase sIdhI taraha bAta karanA cAhie
jo yatImoM ke mAla nAhaqa caTa kara jAyA karate haiM vaha apane peTa meM basa aMgAre bharate haiM aura anaqarIba jahannuma vAsila hoMge

(musalamAnoM) qhudA tumhArI aulAda ke haqa meM tumase vasIyata karatA hai ki lar3ake kA hissA do lar3akiyoM ke barAbara hai aura agara (mayyata kI) aulAda meM sirpha lar3akiyaॉ hI hoM (do) yA (do) se jyAdA to unakA (maqarrara hissA) kula tarke kA do tihAI hai aura agara eka lar3akI ho to usakA AdhA hai aura mayyata ke bApa maॉ hara eka kA agara mayyata kI koI aulAda maujUda na ho to mAla mustarada kA meM se muayyana (qhAsa cIz2oM meM) chaTA hissA hai aura agara mayyata ke koI aulAda na ho aura usake sirpha maॉ bApa hI vArisa hoM to maॉ kA muayyana (qhAsa cIz2oM meM) eka tihAI hissA taya hai aura bAqI bApa kA lekina agara mayyata ke (haqIqI aura sautele) bhAI bhI maujUda hoM to (agarace unheM kucha na mile) usa vakta maॉ kA hissA chaThA hI hogA (aura vaha bhI) mayyata neM jisake bAre meM vasIyata kI hai usakI tAlIma aura (adAe) qarz2a ke bAda tumhAre bApa hoM yA beTe tuma to yaha nahIM jAnate hoM ki usameM kauna tumhArI nAfaramAnI meM jyAdA qarIba hai (phira tuma kyA daqhala de sakate ho) hissA to sirpha qhudA kI tarafa se muayyana hotA hai kyoMki qhudA to z2arUra hara cIz2a ko jAnatA aura tadabIra vAlA hai

aura jo kucha tumhArI bIviyAM chor3a kara (mara) jAe pasa agara unake koI aulAda na ho to tumhArA AdhA hai aura agara unake koI aulAda ho to jo kucha vaha tarakA chor3e usameM se bAz2a cIz2oM meM cauthAI tumhArA hai (aura vaha bhI) aurata ne jisakI vasIyata kI ho aura (adAe) qarz2a ke bAda agara tumhAre koI aulAda na ho to tumhAre tarake meM se tumhArI bIviyoM kA bAz2a cIz2oM meM cauthAI hai aura agara tumhArI koI aulAda ho to tumhAre tarke meM se unakA qhAsa cIz2oM meM AThavaॉ hissA hai (aura vaha bhI) tumane jisake bAre meM vasIyata kI hai usakI tAmIla aura (adAe) qarz2a ke bAda aura agara koI marda yA aurata apanI mAdarajiloM (khyAlI) bhAI yA bahana ko vArisa chor3e to unameM se hara eka kA qhAsa cIjoM meM chaThA hissA hai aura agara usase jyAdA ho to sabake saba eka qhAsa tihAI meM zarIqa raheMge aura (ye saba) mayyata ne jisake bAre meM vasIyata kI hai usakI tAmIla aura (adAe) qarja qe bAda magara haॉ vaha vasIyata (vArisoM ko khvAha makhvAha) nuksAna pahuMcAne vAlI na ho (taba) ye vasIyata qhudA kI tarafa se hai aura qhudA to hara cIz2a kA jAnane vAlA aura burdabAra hai

yaha qhudA kI (muqarrara kI huI) hadeM haiM aura qhudA aura rasUla kI itAata kare usako qhudA Aqherata meM aise (hara bhare) bAg2oM meM pahuMcA degA jisake nIce nahareM jArI hoMgI aura vaha unameM hamezA (caina se) raheMge aura yahI to bar3I kAmayAbI hai
aura jisa zakhsa se qhudA va rasUla kI nAfaramAnI kI aura usakI hadoM se guz2ara gayA to basa qhudA usako jahannuma meM dAqhila karegA

aura vaha usameM hamezA apanA kiyA bhugatatA rahegA aura usake lie bar3I rUsavAI kA az2Aba hai aura tumhArI auratoM meM se jo aurateM badakArI kareM to unakI badakArI para apane logoM meM se cAra gavAhI lo aura phira agara cAroM gavAha usakI tasadIqa kareM to (usakI saz2A ye hai ki) unako gharoM meM banda rakho yahaॉ taka ki mauta A jAe yA qhudA unakI koI (dUsarI) rAha nikAle

aura tuma logoM meM se jinase badakArI saraz2ada huI ho unako mAro pITo phira agara vaha donoM (apanI harakata se) taubA kareM aura islAha kara leM to unako chor3a do bezaka qhudA bar3A taubA kubUla karane vAlA meharabAna hai

magara qhudA kI bAragAha meM taubA to sirpha unhIM logoM kI (ThIka) hai jo nAdAnistA burI harakata kara baiThe (aura) phira jaldI se taubA kara le to qhudA bhI aise logoM kI taubA qubUla kara letA hai aura qhudA to bar3A jAnane vAlA hakIma hai

aura taubA una logoM ke liye (mufIda) nahIM hai jo (umra bhara) to bure kAma karate rahe yahaॉ taka ki jaba unameM se kisI ke sara para mauta A khar3I huI to kahane lage aba maiMne taubA kI aura (isI taraha) una logoM ke lie (bhI taubA) mufIda nahIM hai jo kufra hI kI hAlata meM mara gaye aise hI logoM ke vAste hamane dardanAka az2Aba taiyAra kara rakhA hai

ai ImAnadAroM tumako ye jAyaz2a nahIM ki (apane murisa kI) auratoM se (nikAha kara) ke (khvAha mA khvAha) z2abaradastI vArisa bana jAo aura jo kucha tumane unheM (zauhara ke tarke se) diyA hai usameM se kucha (Apasa se kucha vApasa lene kI nIyata se) unheM dUsare ke sAtha (nikAha karane se) na roko haॉ jaba vaha khullama khullA koI badakArI kareM to alabattA rokane meM (maz2AeqA (harja)nahIM) aura bIviyoM ke sAtha acchA sulUka karate raho aura agara tuma kisI vajaha se unheM nApasanda karo (to bhI sabra karo kyoMki) ajaba nahIM ki kisI cIz2a ko tuma nApasanda karate ho aura qhudA tumhAre lie usameM bahuta behatarI kara de

aura agara tuma eka bIvI (ko talAqa dekara usa) kI jagaha dUsarI bIvI (nikAha karake) tabadIla karanA cAho to agarace tuma unameM se eka ko (jise talAqa denA cAhate ho) bahuta sA mAla de cuke ho to tuma unameM se kucha (vApasa na lo) kyA tumhArI yahI gairata hai ki (khvAha mA khvAha) bohatAna baॉdhakara yA sarIhI jurma lagAkara vApasa le lo
aura kyA tuma usako (vApasa loge hAlaॉki tumameM se) eka dUsare ke sAtha qhilavata kara cukA hai aura bIviyaॉ tumase (nikAha ke vakta nuqafA vagairaha kA) pakkA qarAra le cukI haiM

aura jina auratoM se tumhAre bApa dAdAoM se (nikAha) jamAa (agarace z2inA) kiyA ho tuma unase nikAha na karo magara jo ho cukA (vaha to ho cukA) vaha badakArI aura qhudA kI nAqhuzI kI bAta z2arUra thI aura bahuta burA tarIqA thA

(musalamAnoM hasabe jela) aurateM tuma para harAma kI gayI haiM tumhArI mAeM (dAdI nAnI vagairaha saba) aura tumhArI beTiyaॉ (potiyaॉ) navAsiyaॉ (vagairaha) aura tumhArI bahaneM aura tumhArI phuphiyaॉ aura tumhArI qhAlAeM aura bhatIjiyaॉ aura bhaMjiyaॉ aura tumhArI vaha mAeM jinhoMne tumako dUdha pilAyA hai aura tumhArI raz2AI (dUdha zarIka) bahaneM aura tumhArI bIvIyoM kI mA~e aura vaha (mAdara z2ilo) lar3akiyAM jo tumhArI goda meM paravariza pA cukI ho aura una auratoM (ke peTa) se (paidA huI) haiM jinase tuma hamabistarI kara cuke ho hA~ agara tumane una bIviyoM se (sirpha nikAha kiyA ho) hamabistarI na kI to alabattA una mAdaraz2iloM (lar3akiyoM se) nikAha (karane meM) tuma para kucha gunAha nahIM hai aura tumhAre sulabI lar3ako (potoM navAsoM vagairaha) kI bIviyaॉ (bahueM) aura do bahanoM se eka sAtha nikAha karanA magara jo ho cukA (vaha mAfa hai) bezaka qhudA bar3A bakhzane vAlA meharabAna hai

aura zauharadAra aurateM magara vaha aurateM jo (jihAda meM kuphfAra se) tumhAre kabz2e meM A jAeM harAma nahIM (ye) qhudA kA taharIrI hukma (hai jo) tumapara (farz2a kiyA gayA) hai aura una auratoM ke sivA (aura aurateM) tumhAre lie jAyaz2a haiM bazarte ki badakArI va z2inA nahIM balki tuma iphfata yA pAkadAminI kI g2araz2a se apane mAla (va mehara) ke badale (nikAha karanA) cAho haॉ jina auratoM se tumane mutAa kiyA ho to unheM jo mehara muayyana kiyA hai de do aura mehara ke muqarrara hone ke bAda agara Apasa meM (kama va beza para) rAz2I ho jAo to usameM tumapara kucha gunAha nahIM hai bezaka qhudA (hara cIz2a se) vAqifa aura masalehatoM kA pahacAnane vAlA hai

aura tumameM se jo zakhsa Az2Ada iphfatadAra auratoM se nikAha karane kI mAlI haisiyata se qudarata na rakhatA ho to vaha tumhArI una mominA launDiyoM se jo tumhAre kabz2e meM haiM nikAha kara sakatA hai aura qhudA tumhAre ImAna se qhUba vAqifa hai (ImAna kI haisiyata se to) tumameM eka dUsare kA hamajinsa hai pasa (be tAmmula) unake mAlikoM kI ijAz2ata se launDiyoM se nikAha karo aura unakA mehara husne sulUka se de do magara unhIM (launDiyo) se nikAha karo jo iphfata ke sAtha tumhArI pAbanda raheM na to khule Ama z2inA karanA cAheM aura na corI chipe se AzanAI phira jaba tumhArI pAbanda ho cukI usake bAda koI badakArI kare to jo saz2A Az2Ada bIviyoM ko dI jAtI hai usakI AdhI (saz2A) launDiyoM ko dI jAegI (aura launDiyoM) se nikAha kara bhI sakatA hai to vaha zakhsa jisako z2inA meM mubtilA ho jAne kA qhaufa ho aura sabra kare to tumhAre haqa meM jyAdA behatara hai aura qhudA bakhzane vAlA meharabAna hai

(qhaira duniyA meM to jo cAhe kareM) bhalA usa vakta kyA hAla hogA jaba hama hara giroha ke gavAha talaba kareMge aura (mohammada) tumako una saba para gavAha kI haisiyata meM talaba kareMge

(ai rasUla) kyA tUmane una logoM ke hAla para naz2ara nahIM kI jinheM kitAbe qhudA kA kucha hissA diyA gayA thA (magara) vaha loga (hidAyata ke badale) gumarAhI qharIdane lage unakI aina murAda yaha hai ki tuma bhI rAhe rAsta se bahaka jAo

(ai rasUla) yahUda se kucha loga aise bhI haiM jo bAtoM meM unake mahala va mauqe se hera phera DAla dete haiM aura apanI z2abAnoM ko maror3akara aura dIna para tAnAz2anI kI rAha se tumase sameanA va asainA (hamane sunA aura nAfaramAnI kI) aura vasamaa gairA musamaina (tuma merI suno qhudA tumako na sunavAe) rAanA merA khyAla karo mere caravAhe kahA karate haiM aura agara vaha isake badale sameanA va atAanA (hamane sunA aura mAnA) aura isamAA (merI suno) aura (rAanA) ke evaz2a unajuranA (hamapara nigAha rakha) kahate to unake haqa meM kahIM behatara hotA aura bilkula sIdhI bAta thI magara unapara to unake kufra kI vajaha se qhudA kI fiTakAra hai

aura qhudA kA hukma kiyA karAyA huA kAma samajho qhudA usa jurma ko to alabattA nahIM mAfa karatA ki usake sAtha zirka kiyA jAe haॉ usake sivA jo gunAha ho jisako cAhe mAfa kara de aura jisane (kisI ko) qhudA kA zarIka banAyA to usane bar3e gunAha kA tUphAna baॉdhA

(ai rasUla) kyA tumane una logoM ke hAla para naz2ara nahIM kI jo Apa bar3e muqaddasa banate haiM (magara usase kyA hotA hai) balki qhudA jise cAhatA hai muqaddasa banAtA hai aura z2ulma to kisI para dhAge ke barAbara ho hI gA nahIM

(ai rasUla) yahI vaha loga haiM jinapara qhudA ne lAnata kI hai aura jisa para qhudA ne lAnata kI hai tuma unakA madadagAra haragiz2a kisI ko na pAoge

(ye loga tumhAre sAmane) to kaha dete haiM ki hama (Apake) faramAbaradAra haiM lekina jaba tumhAre pAsa se bAhara nikale to unameM se kucha loga jo kucha tumase kaha cuke the usake qhilAfa rAtoM ko mazavarA karate haiM hAlaॉki (ye nahIM samajhate) ye loga rAtoM ko jo kucha bhI mazavarA karate haiM use qhudA likhatA jAtA hai pAsa tuma una logoM kI kucha paravAha na karo aura qhudA para bharosA rakho aura qhudA kArasAz2I ke lie kAfI hai
to kyA ye loga qurAna meM bhI g2aura nahIM karate aura (ye nahIM khyAla karate ki) agara qhudA ke sivA kisI aura kI tarafa se (AyA) hotA to z2arUra usameM bar3A ikhtelAfa pAte

aura jaba unake (musalamAnoM ke) pAsa amana yA qhaufa kI qhabara AyI to use faurana mazahUra kara dete haiM hAlaॉki agara vaha usakI qhabara ko rasUla (yA) aura ImAnadAro meM se jo sAhabAne hukUmata taka pahuMcAte to bezaka jo loga unameM se usakI tahaqIqa karane vAle haiM (paig2ambara yA valI) usako samajha lete ki (mazahUra karane kI z2arUrata hai yA nahIM) aura (musalamAnoM) agara tumapara qhudA kA faz2ala (va karama) aura usakI meharabAnI na hotI to canda AdamiyoM ke sivA tuma sabake saba zaitAna kI pairavI karane lagate

pasa (ai rasUla) tuma qhudA kI rAha meM jihAda karo aura tuma apanI z2Ata ke sivA kisI aura ke z2immedAra nahIM ho aura ImAnadAroM ko (jehAda kI) tarag2Iba do aura anaqarIba qhudA kAfiroM kI haibata roka degA aura qhudA kI haibata sabase jyAdA hai aura usakI saz2A bahuta sakhta hai

jo zakhsa acche kAma kI sifAriza kare to usako bhI usa kAma ke savAba se kucha hissA milegA aura jo bure kAma kI sifAriza kare to usako bhI usI kAma kI saz2A kA kucha hissA milegA aura qhudA to hara cIz2a para nigehabAna hai
aura jaba koI zakhsa salAma kare to tuma bhI usake javAba meM usase behatara tarIqe se salAma karo yA vahI laphz2a javAba meM kaha do bezaka qhudA hara cIz2a kA hisAba karane vAlA hai

allAha to vahI paravaradigAra hai jisake sivA koI qAbile parastiza nahIM vaha tumako qayAmata ke dina jisameM z2arA bhI zaka nahIM z2arUra ikaTThA karegA aura qhudA se baढ़kara bAta meM saccA kauna hogA

(musalamAnoM) phira tumako kyA ho gayA hai ki tuma munAfiqoM ke bAre meM do farIqa ho gae ho (eka muvAfiqa eka muqhAlifa) hAlaॉki qhuda qhudA ne unake karatUtoM kI badaulata unakI akloM ko ulaTa pulaTa diyA hai kyA tuma ye cAhate ho ki jisako qhudA ne gumarAhI meM chor3a diyA hai tuma use rAhe rAsta para le Ao hAlaॉki qhudA ne jisako gumarAhI meM chor3a diyA hai usake lie tumameM se koI zakhsa rAstA nikAla hI nahIM sakatA

una logoM kI khvAhiza to ye hai ki jisa taraha vaha kAfira ho gae tuma bhI kAfira ho jAo tAki tuma unake barAbara ho jAo pasa jaba taka vaha qhudA kI rAha meM hijarata na kareM to unameM se kisI ko dosta na banAo phira agara vaha usase bhI muMha mor3eM to unheM giraphtAra karo aura jahaॉ pAo unako qatla karo aura unameM se kisI ko na apanA dosta banAo na madadagAra

magara jo loga kisI aisI qauma se jA mileM ki tumameM aura unameM (sulaha kA) ehada va paimAna ho cukA hai yA tumase jaMga karane yA apanI qauma ke sAtha lar3ane se dilataMga hokara tumhAre pAsa Ae hoM (to unheM Az2Ara na pahuMcAo) aura agara qhudA cAhatA to unako tumapara g2alabA detA to vaha tumase z2arUra lar3a par3ate pasa agara vaha tumase kinArA kazI kare aura tumase na lar3e aura tumhAre pAsa sulAha kA paig2Ama de to tumhAre lie una logoM para Az2Ara pahuMcAne kI qhudA ne koI sabIla nahIM nikAlI

anaqarIba tuma kucha aise aura logoM ko bhI pAoge jo cAhate haiM ki tumase bhI amana meM raheM aura apanI qauma se bhI amana meM raheM (magara) jaba kabhI jhagar3e kI tarafa bulAe gae to usameM auMdhe muMha ke bala gira par3e pasa agara vaha tumase na kinArA kazI kareM aura na tumheM sulaha kA paig2Ama deM aura na lar3AI se apane hAtha rokeM pasa unako pakar3oM aura jahaॉ pAo unako qatla karo aura yahI vaha loga haiM jinapara hamane tumheM sarIhI g2alabA atA faramAyA

aura kisI ImAnadAra ko ye jAyaz2a nahIM ki kisI momina ko jAna se mAra DAle magara dhokhe se (qatla kiyA ho to dUsarI bAta hai) aura jo zakhsa kisI momina ko dhokhe se (bhI) mAra DAle to (usapara) eka ImAnadAra gulAma kA Az2Ada karanA aura maqatUla ke qarAbatadAroM ko khUMna bahA denA (lAz2ima) hai magara jaba vaha loga mAfa kareM phira agara maqatUla una logoM meM se ho vaha jo tumhAre duzamana (kAfira harabI) haiM aura qhuda qAtila momina hai to (sirpha) eka musalamAna g2ulAma kA Az2Ada karanA aura agara maqatUla una (kAfira) logoM meM kA ho jinase tuma se ehada va paimAna ho cukA hai to (qAtila para) vArise maqatUla ko qhUna bahA denA aura eka bandae momina kA Az2Ada karanA (vAjiba) hai fira jo zakhsa (g2ulAma Az2Ada karane ko) na pAye to usakA kuphfArA qhudA kI tarafa se lagAtAra do mahIne ke roz2e haiM aura qhudA qhUba vAkifakAra (aura) hikamata vAlA hai

aura jo zakhsa kisI momina ko jAnabUjha ke mAra DAle (g2ulAma kI Az2AdI vagairaha usakA kuphfArA nahIM balki) usakI saz2A doz2aka hai aura vaha usameM hamezA rahegA usapara qhudA ne (apanA) g2az2aba DhAyA hai aura usapara lAnata kI hai aura usake lie bar3A sakhta az2Aba taiyAra kara rakhA hai

ai ImAnadAroM jaba tuma qhudA kI rAha meM (jehAda karane ko) safara karo to (kisI ke qatla karane meM jaldI na karo balki) acchI taraha jaॉca kara liyA karo aura jo zakhsa (iz2ahAre islAma kI g2araz2a se) tumhe salAma kare to tuma be soce samajhe na kaha diyA karo ki tU ImAnadAra nahIM hai (isase z2Ahira hotA hai) ki tuma (fakta) duniyAvI AsAiza kI tamannA rakhate ho magara isI bahAne qatla karake lUTa lo aura ye nahIM samajhate ki (agara yahI hai) to qhudA ke yahaॉ bahuta se g2anImateM haiM (musalamAnoM) pahale tuma qhuda bhI to aise hI the phira qhudA ne tumapara ehasAna kiyA (ki bekhaTake musalamAna ho gae) g2araz2a qhUba chAnabIna kara liyA karo bezaka qhudA tumhAre hara kAma se qhabaradAra hai

mAz2Ura logoM ke sivA jehAda se muMha chipA ke ghara meM baiThane vAle aura qhudA kI rAha meM apane jAna va mAla se jihAda karane vAle haragiz2a barAbara nahIM ho sakate (balki) apane jAna va mAla se jihAda karane vAloM ko ghara baiThe rahane vAleM para qhudA ne daraje ke etabAra se bar3I faz2Ilata dI hai (agarace) qhudA ne saba ImAnadAroM se (khvAha jihAda kareM yA na kareM) bhalAI kA vAyadA kara liyA hai magara g2Az2iyoM ko khAnA nazInoM para az2Ima savAba ke etabAra se qhudA ne bar3I faz2Ilata dI hai
(yAnI unheM) apanI tarafa se bar3e bar3e daraje aura bakhziza aura rahamata (atA faramAegA) aura qhudA to bar3A bakhzane vAlA meharabAna hai

bezaka jina logoM kI qabje rUha farizte ne usa vaqata kI hai ki (dArUla haraba meM par3e) apanI jAnoM para z2ulma kara rahe the aura farizte kabje rUha ke bAda hairata se kahate haiM tuma kisa (hAlata) g2afalata meM the to vaha (mAz2erata ke lahaje meM) kahate hai ki hama to rUe z2amIna meM bekasa the to farizte kahate haiM ki qhudA kI (aisI lambI caur3I) z2amIna meM itanI sI gunjAiza na thI ki tuma (kahIM) hijarata karake cale jAte pasa aise logoM kA ThikAnA jahannuma hai aura vaha burA ThikAnA hai
magara jo marda aura aurateM aura bacce isa qadara bebasa haiM ki na to (dArUla haraba se nikalane kI) kAI tadabIra kara sakate haiM aura unakI rihAI kI koI rAha dikhAI detI hai
to ummIda hai ki qhudA aise logoM se daraguz2are aura qhudA to bar3A mAfa karane vAlA aura bakhzane vAlA hai

aura jo zakhsa qhudA kI rAha meM hijarata karegA to vaha rUe z2amIna meM bA farAg2ata (caina se rahane sahane ke) bahuta se kuzAdA maqAma pAegA aura jo zakhsa apane ghara se jilAvatana hoke qhudA aura usake rasUla kI tarafa nikala qhar3A huA phira use (maMz2ile maqasUda) taka pahuMcane se pahale mauta A jAe to qhudA para usakA savAba lAz2ima ho gayA aura qhudA to bar3A bakhza ne vAlA meharabAna hai hI

(musalamAnoM jaba tuma rUe z2amIna para safara karo) aura tumako isa amra kA qhaufa ho ki kuphfAra (asanAe namAz2a meM) tumase fasAda kareMge to usameM tumhAre vAste kucha muz2AeqA nahIM ki namAz2a meM kucha kama kara diyA karo bezaka kuphfAra to tumhAre qhullama qhullA duzmana haiM

aura (ai rasUla) tuma musalamAnoM meM maujUda ho aura (lar3AI ho rahI ho) ki tuma unako namAz2a paढ़Ane lago to (do giroha karake) eka ko lar3AI ke vAste chor3a do (aura) unameM se eka jamAata tumhAre sAtha namAz2a paढ़e aura apane harabe taiyAra apane sAtha lie rahe phira jaba (pahalI rakaata ke) sajade kara (dUsarI rakaata phurAdA paढ़) le to tumhAre pIche puzta panAha baneM aura dUsarI jamAata jo (lar3a rahI thI aura) jaba taka namAz2a nahIM paढ़ne pAyI hai aura (tumhArI dUsarI rakaata meM) tumhAre sAtha namAz2a paढ़e aura apanI hifAz2ata kI cIje aaura apane hathiyAra (namAz2a meM sAtha) lie rahe kuphfAra to ye cAhate hI haiM ki kAza apane hathiyAroM aura apane sAz2a va sAmAna se z2arA bhI g2afalata karo to eka bAragI sabake saba tuma para TUTa par3eM haॉ alabattA usameM kucha muz2AeqA nahIM ki (ittefAqana) tumako bAriza ke sababa se kucha takalIfa pahuMce yA tuma bImAra ho to apane hathiyAra (namAz2a meM) utAra ke rakha do aura apanI hifAz2ata karate raho aura qhudA ne to kAfiroM ke lie z2illata kA az2Aba taiyAra kara rakhA hai

phira jaba tuma namAz2a adA kara cuko to uThate baiThate leTate (g2araz2a hara hAla meM) qhudA ko yAda karo phira jaba tuma (duzmanoM se) mutamaIna ho jAo to (apane maamUla) ke mutAbiqa namAz2a paढ़A karo kyoMki namAz2a to ImAnadAroM para vakta mutayyana karake farz2a kI gayI hai

aura (musalamAnoM) duzamanoM ke pIchA karane meM sustI na karo agara lar3AI meM tumako takalIfa pahuMcatI hai to jaisI tumako takalIfa pahuMcatI hai unako bhI vaisI hI az2Iyata hotI hai aura (tumako) ye bhI (ummIda hai ki) tuma qhudA se vaha vaha ummIdeM rakhate ho jo (unako) nasIba nahIM aura qhudA to sabase vAqifa (aura) hikamata vAlA hai
(ai rasUla) hamane tumapara barahaqa kitAba isalie nAz2ila kI hai ki qhudA ne tumhArI hidAyata kI hai usI taraha logoM ke daramiyAna faisalA karo aura khyAnata karane vAloM ke tarafadAra na bano
aura (apanI ummata ke liye) qhudA se mag2afirata kI duA maॉgoM bezaka qhudA bar3A bakhzane vAlA meharabAna hai
aura (ai rasUla) tuma (una badamAzoM) kI tarafa hokara (logoM se) na lar3o jo apane hI (logoM) se dag2AbAz2I karate haiM bezaka qhudA aise zakhsa ko dosta nahIM rakhatA jo dag2AbAz2a gunAhagAra ho

(musalamAnoM) qhabaradAra ho jAo bhalA duniyA kI (z2arA sI) z2indagI meM to tuma unakI tarafa hokara lar3ane khaDe ho gae (magara ye to batAo) phira qayAmata ke dina unakA tarafadAra banakara qhudA se kauna lar3egA yA kauna unakA vakIla hogA
aura jo zakhsa koI burA kAma kare yA (kisI taraha) apane naphsa para z2ulma kare usake bAda qhudA se apanI mag2afirata kI duA maॉge to qhudA ko bar3A bakhzane vAlA meharabAna pAegA
aura jo zakhsa koI gunAha karatA hai to usase kucha apanA hI nuqasAna karatA hai aura qhudA to (hara cIz2a se) vAqifa (aura) bar3I tadabIra vAlA hai
aura jo zakhsa koI qhatA yA gunAha kare phira use kisI beqasUra ke sara thope to usane eka bar3e (ifaterA) aura sarIhI gunAha ko apane Upara lAda liyA

aura (ai rasUla) agara tumapara qhudA kA faz2ala (va karama) aura usakI meharabAnI na hotI to una (badamAzoM) meM se eka giroha tumako gumarAha karane kA z2arUra qasada karatA hAlaॉki vaha loga basa apane Apa ko gumarAha kara rahe haiM aura yaha loga tumheM kucha bhI z2arara nahIM pahuMcA sakate aura qhudA hI ne to (meharabAnI kI ki) tumapara apanI kitAba aura hikamata nAz2ila kI aura jo bAteM tuma nahIM jAnate the tumheM sikhA dI aura tuma para to qhudA kA bar3A faz2ala hai

(ai rasUla) unake rAz2a kI bAtoM meM aksara meM bhalAI (kA to nAma taka) nahIM magara (haॉ) jo zakhsa kisI ko sadaqA dene yA acche kAma kare yA logoM ke daramiyAna mela milApa karAne kA hukma de (to alabattA eka bAta hai) aura jo zakhsa (mahaz2a) qhudA kI qhuzanUdI kI khvAhiza meM aise kAma karegA to hama anaqarIba hI use bar3A acchA badalA atA pharamAeMge

aura jo zakhsa rAhe rAsta ke z2Ahira hone ke bAda rasUla se sarakazI kare aura mominIna ke tarIqe ke sivA kisI aura rAha para cale to jidhara vaha phira gayA hai hama bhI udhara hI phera deMge aura (Aqhira) use jahannuma meM jhoMka deMge aura vaha to bahuta hI burA ThikAnA

qhudA bezaka usako to nahIM bakhzatA ki usakA koI aura zarIka banAyA jAe haॉ usake sivA jo gunAha ho jisako cAhe bakhza de aura (mAz2a allAha) jisane kisI ko qhudA kA zarIka banAyA to vaha basa bhaTaka ke bahuta dUra jA par3A
muzarekIna qhudA ko chor3akara basa auratoM hI kI parasatiza karate haiM (yAnI butoM kI jo unake) khyAla meM aurateM haiM (dara haqIqata) ye loga sarakaza zaitAna kI parasatiza karate haiM
jisapara qhudA ne lAnata kI hai aura jisane (ibtidA hI meM) kahA thA ki (qhudAvandA) maiM tere bandoM meM se kucha qhAsa logoM ko (apanI tarapha) z2arUra le lUMgA

zaitAna unase acche acche vAyade bhI karatA hai (aura bar3I bar3I) ummIdeM bhI dilAtA hai aura zaitAna unase jo kucha vAyade bhI karatA hai vaha basa nirA dhokhA (hI dhokhA) hai
yahI to vaha loga haiM jinakA ThikAnA basa jahannuma hai aura vahaॉ se bhAgane kI jagaha bhI na pAeMge

aura jina logoM ne ImAna qubUla kiyA aura acche acche kAma kie unheM hama anaqarIba hI (behizta ke) una (hare bhare) bAg2oM meM jA pahuMcAegeM jinake (darakhtoM ke) nIce nahareM jArI hoMgI aura ye loga usameM hamezA AbAdula AbAda taka raheMge (ye unase) qhudA kA pakkA vAyadA hai aura qhudA se jyAdA (apanI) bAta meM saccA kauna hogA

na tuma logoM kI Araz2U se (kucha kAma cala sakatA hai) na ahale kitAba kI tamannA se kucha hAsila ho sakatA hai balki (jaisA kAma vaisA dAma) jo burA kAma karegA use usakA badalA diyA jAegA aura phira qhudA ke sivA kisI ko na to apanA saraparasta pAegA aura na madadagAra
aura jo zakhsa acche acche kAma karegA (khvAha) marda ho yA aurata aura ImAnadAra (bhI) ho to aise loga behizta meM (bekhaTake) jA pahuMceMge aura unapara tila bhI z2ulma na kiyA jAegA

aura usa zakhsa se dIna meM behatara kauna hogA jisane qhudA ke sAmane apanA sare tasalIma jhukA diyA aura neko kAra bhI hai aura ibarAhIma ke tarIke para calatA hai jo bAtila se katarA kara calate the aura qhudA ne ibrAhima ko to apanA qhalisa dosta banA liyA
aura jo kucha AsamAnoM meM hai aura jo kucha z2amIna meM hai (g2araz2a saba kucha) qhudA hI kA hai aura qhudA hI saba cIz2a ko (apanI) kudarata se ghere hue hai

(ai rasUla) ye loga tumase (yatIma lar3akiyoM) se nikAha ke bAre meM fatavA talaba karate haiM tuma unase kaha do ki qhudA tumheM unase (nikAha karane) kI ijAz2ata detA hai aura jo hukma manAhI kA kurAna meM tumheM (pahale) sunAyA jA cukA hai vaha haqIqatana una yatIma lar3akiyoM ke vAste thA jinheM tuma unakA muayyana kiyA huA haqa nahIM dete aura cAhate ho (ki yUM hI) unase nikAha kara lo aura una kamaz2ora nAtavaॉ (kamajora) baccoM ke bAre meM hukma faramAtA hai aura (vo) ye hai ki tuma yatImoM ke huqUqa ke bAre meM insApha para qAyama raho aura (yaqIna rakho ki) jo kucha tuma nekI karoge to qhudA z2arUra vAqifakAra hai

aura agara koI aurata apane zauhara kI jyAdatI va betavajjohI se (talAqa kA) qhaufa rakhatI ho to miyaॉ bIvI ke bAhama kisI taraha milApa kara lene meM donoM (meM se kisI para) kucha gunAha nahIM hai aura sulaha to (baharahAla) behatara hai aura bukhla se to qarIba qarIba hara tabiyata ke hama pahalU hai aura agara tuma nekI karo aura parahejadArI karo to qhudA tumhAre hara kAma se qhabaradAra hai (vahI tumako ajra degA)

aura agarace tuma bahuterA cAho (lekina) tumameM itanI sakata to haragiz2a nahIM hai ki apanI kaI bIviyoM meM (pUrA pUrA) insAfa kara sako (magara) aisA bhI to na karo ki (eka hI kI tarafa) hamAtana mAela ho jAo ki (dUsarI ko adhar3a meM) laTakI huI chor3a do aura agara bAhama mela kara lo aura (jyAdatI se) bace raho to qhudA yaqInana bar3A bakhzane vAlA meharabAna hai

aura agara donoM miyaॉ bIvI eka dUsare se bAz2arie talAqa judA ho jAeM to qhudA apane vasI qhaz2Ane se (farAgula bAlI atA faramAkara) donoM ko (eka dUsare se) beniyAz2a kara degA aura qhudA to bar3I gunjAiza aura tadabIra vAlA hai aura jo kucha AsamAnoM meM hai aura jo kucha z2amIna meM hai (g2araja saba kucha) qhudA hI kA hai

aura jina logoM ko tumase pahale kitAbe qhudA atA kI gayI hai unako aura tumako bhI usakI hamane vasIyata kI thI ki (qhudA) (kI nAfaramAnI) se Darate raho aura agara (kahIM) tumane kufra ikhteyAra kiyA to (yAda rahe ki) jo kucha AsamAnoM meM hai aura jo kucha z2amIna meM hai (g2araja saba kucha) qhudA hI kA hai (jo cAhe kara sakatA hai) aura qhudA to sabase beparavA aura (hamA sifata) mausUfa hara hamda vAlA hai
jo kucha AsamAnoM meM hai aura jo kucha z2amIna meM hai (g2araja saba kucha) qhAsa qhudA hI kA hai aura qhudA to kArasAz2I ke liye kAfI hai

vaha (DhiThAI se) kahane lagA maiM aisA gayA guz2arA to hU~ nahIM ki aise AdamI ko sajadA kara baiThU~ jise tUne sar3I huI khana khana bolane vAlI miTTI se paidA kiyA hai

yahI vaha beihazta hai ki hamAre bandoM meM se jo parahez2agAra hogA hama use usakA vArisa banAyege

aura (ai rasUla) hama loga farizte Apa ke paravaradigAra ke hukma ke bag2aira (duniyA meM) nahIM nAz2ila hote jo kucha hamAre sAmane hai aura jo kucha hamAre pITha pIche hai aura jo kucha unake daramiyAna meM hai (g2araz2a sabakucha) usI kA hai

aura tumhArA paravaradigAra kucha bhUlane vAlA nahIM hai sAre AsamAna aura z2amIna kA mAlika hai aura una cIz2oM kA bhI jo donoM ke daramiyAna meM hai to tuma usakI ibAdata karo (aura usakI ibAdata para sAbita) qadama raho bhalA tumhAre ilma meM usakA koI hamanAma bhI hai
aura (bAz2a) AdamI abI bina qhalapha tAjjuba se kahA karate haiM ki kyA jaba maiM mara jAU~gA to jaldI hI jItA jAgatA (qabra se) nikAlA jAU~gA
kyA vaha (AdamI) usako nahIM yAda karatA ki usako isase pahale jaba vaha kucha bhI na thA paidA kiyA thA
to vaha (ai rasUla) tumhAre paravaradigAra kI (apanI) qisma hama unako aura zaitAna ko ikaTThA karege phira una saba ko jahannuma ke girdAgirda ghuTanoM ke bala hAz2ira kareMge
phira hara giroha meM se aise logoM ko alaga nikAla leMge (jo duniyA meM) khudA se auroM kI nisbata akar3e-akar3e phirate the
phira jo loga jahannuma meM jhoMke jAe~ge jyAdA saz2AvAra haiM hama unase khUba vAqipha haiM
aura tumame se koI aisA nahIM jo jahannuma para se hokara na guz2are (kyoMki pula sirAta usI para hai) ye tumhAre paravaradigAra para hetemI aura lAz2amI (vAyadA) hai
phira hama parahez2agAroM ko bacAe~ge aura nAfaramAnoM ko ghuTane ke bhala usameM chor3a deMge

aura jaba hamArI vAz2ee rauzana AyateM unake sAmane paढ़I jAtI haiM to jina logoM ne kufra kiyA ImAnavAloM se pUchate haiM bhalA ye to batAo ki hama tuma donoM pharIqo meM se maratabe meM kauna jyAdA behatara hai aura kisakI mahaphila jyAdA acchI hai
hAlA~ki hamane unase pahale bahuta sI jamAatoM ko halAka kara chor3A jo unase sAz2o sAmAna aura z2AhirI namUda meM kahIM baढ़ caढ़ ke thI

(ai rasUla) kaha do ki jo zakhsa gumarAhI meM par3A hai to khudA usako ढ़Ila hI detA calA jAtA hai yahA~ taka ki usa cIz2a ko (apanI ऑMkhoM se) dekha leMge jinakA unase vAyadA kiyA gayA hai yA az2Aba yA qayAmata to usa vakta unheM mAlUma ho jAegA ki maratabe meM kauna badatara hai aura lazkara (jatthe) meM kauna kamaz2ora hai (bekasa) hai

aura jo loga rAhe rAsta para haiM khudA unakI hidAyata aura jyAdA karatA jAtA hai aura bAqI raha jAne vAlI nekiyA~ tumhAre paravaradigAra ke naz2adIka savAba kI rAha se bhI behatara hai aura anjAma ke aitabAra se (bhI) behatara hai
(ai rasUla) kyA tumane usa zakhsa para bhI naz2ara kI jisane hamArI AyatoM se inkAra kiyA aura kahane lagA ki (agara qayAmata huIto bhI) mujhe mAla aura aulAda z2arUra milegI
kyA use g2aiba kA hAla mAlUma ho gayA hai yA usane khudA se koI ahada (va paimAna) le rakhA hai harag2ija nahIM
jo kucha ye bakatA hai (saba) hama sabhI se likhe lete haiM aura usake lie aura jyAdA az2Aba baढ़Ate haiM
aura vo mAla va aulAda kI nisbata baka rahA hai hama hI usake mAlika ho baiTheMge aura ye hamAre pAsa tanahA AyegA
aura una logoM ne khudA ko chor3akara dUsare-dUsare mAbUda banA rakhe haiM tAki vaha unakI ijz2ata ke bAesa hoM harag2iz2a nahIM
(balki) vaha mAbUda khuda unakI ibAdata se inkAra kareMge aura (ulTe) unake duzamana ho jAe~ge
(ai rasUla) kyA tumane isI bAta ko nahIM dekhA ki hamane zaitAna ko kAfiroM para chor3a rakhA hai ki vaha unheM bahakAte rahate haiM
to (ai rasUla) tuma una kAphiroM para (nuz2Ule az2Aba kI) jaldI na karo hama to basa unake lie (az2Aba) kA dina gina rahe haiM
ki jisa dina parahez2agAroM ko (khudAe) rahamAna ke (apane) sAmane mehamAnoM kI taraha taraha jamA kareMge
aura gunehagAroM ko jahannuma kI tarapha pyAse (jAnavaro kI taraha hakA~ege
(usa dina) ye loga siphAriza para bhI qAdira na hoMge magara (vahA~) jisa zakhsa ne qhudA se (siphAriza kA) eqarA le liyA ho
aura (yahUdI) loga kahate haiM ki khudA ne (az2Iz2a ko) beTA banA liyA hai
(ai rasUla) tuma kaha do ki tumane itanI bar3I sakhta bAta apanI tarapha se gaढ़ ke kI hai
ki qarIba hai ki AsamAna usase phaTa par3e aura z2amIna zigAphatA ho jAe aura pahAr3a Tukar3e-TukaDe hokara gira par3e
isa bAta se ki una logoM ne khudA ke lie beTA qarAra diyA
hAlA~ki khudA ke lie ye kisI taraha zAyA~ hI nahIM ki vaha (kisI ko apanA) beTA banA le
sAre AsamAna va z2amIna meM jitanI cIz2e haiM saba kI saba khudA ke sAmane bandA hI banakara Ane vAlI haiM usane yaqInana sabako apane (ilma) ke ahAte meM ghera liyA hai
aura sabako acchI taraha gina liyA hai
aura ye saba usake sAmane qayAmata ke dina akele (akele) hAz2ira hoMge
bezaka jina logoM ne ImAna kubUla kiyA aura acche-acche kAma kie anaqarIba hI khudA una kI mohabbata (logoM ke diloM meM) paidA kara degA

(ai rasUla) hamane usa kurAna ko tumhArI (arabI) jubAna meM sirpha isalie AsAna kara diyA hai ki tuma usake z2arie se parahez2agAroM ko (jannata kI) khuzaqhabarI do aura (araba kI) jhagar3AlU qauma ko (az2Abe khudA se) DarAo
aura hamane unase pahale kitanI jamAatoM ko halAka kara DAlA bhalA tuma unameM se kisI ko (kahIM dekhate ho) usakI kucha bhanaka bhI sunate ho
ai tA hA (rasUlaallAha)
hamane tuma para kurAna isalie nAz2ila nahIM kiyA ki tuma (isa qadara) mazakqata uThAo
magara jo zakhsa khudA se DaratA hai usake lie nasIhata (qarAra diyA hai)
(ye) usa zakhsa kI tarafa se nAz2ila huA hai jisane z2amIna aura U~ce-U~ce AsamAnoM ko paidA kiyA
vahI rahamAna hai jo arza para (hukmarAnI ke lie) AmAdA va mustaIda hai
jo kucha AsamAnoM meM hai aura jo kucha z2amIna meM hai aura jo kucha donoM ke bIca meM hai aura jo kucha z2amIna ke nIce hai (g2araz2a saba kucha) usI kA hai
aura agara tU pukAra kara bAta kare (to bhI AhistA kare to bhI) vaha yaqInana bheda aura usase jyAdA pozIdA cIz2a ko jAnatA hai
allAha (vaha mAbUda hai ki) usake sivA koi mAbUda nahIM hai (acche-acche) usI ke nAma haiM
aura (ai rasUla) kyA tuma taka mUsA kI qhabara pahu~cI hai ki jaba unhoMne dUra se Aga dekhI

to apane ghara ke logoM se kahane lage ki tuma loga (z2arA yahIM) Thaharo maiMne Aga dekhI hai kyA ajaba hai ki maiM vahA~ (jAkara) usameM se eka aMgArA tumhAre pAsa le AU~ yA Aga ke pAsa kisI rAha kA patA pA jAU~
phira jaba mUsA Aga ke pAsa Ae to unheM AvAja AI
ki ai mUsA bezaka maiM hI tumhArA paravaradigAra hU~ to tuma apanI jUtiyA~ utAra DAlo kyoMki tuma (isa vakta) tuA (nAmI) pAqIz2A caTiyala maidAna meM ho
aura maiMne tumako paig2ambarI ke vAste muntaqhiba kiyA (cuna liyA) hai to jo kucha tumhArI tarafa vahI kI jAtI hai use kAna lagA kara suno
isameM zaka nahIM ki maiM hI vaha allAha hU~ ki mere sivA koI mAbUda nahIM to merI hI ibAdata karo aura merI yAda ke lie namAz2a barAbara paढ़A karo
(kyoMki) qayAmata z2arUra Ane vAlI hai aura maiM use lAmahaulA chipAe rakhU~gA tAki hara zakhsa (usake qhaupha se nekI kare) aura vaisI koziza kI hai usakA use badalA diyA jAe
to (kahIM) aisA na ho ki jo zakhsa use dila se nahIM mAnatA aura apanI nafasiyAnI khvAhiza ke pIche par3A vaha tumheM isa (phikra) se roka de to tuma tabAha ho jAoge
aura ai mUsA ye tumhAre dAhine hAtha meM kyA cIz2a hai
arz2a kI ye to merI lAThI hai maiM usa para sahArA karatA hU~ aura isase apanI bakariyoM para (aura darakhtoM kI) pattiyA~ jhAr3atA hU~ aura usameM mere aura bhI matalaba haiM
faramAyA ai mUsA usako z2arA z2amIna para DAla to do mUsA ne use DAla diyA
to faurana vaha sA~pa banakara daur3ane lagA (ye dekhakara mUsA bhAge)
to faramAyA ki tuma isako pakar3a lo aura Daro nahIM maiM abhI isakI pahalI sI sUrata phira kie detA hU~
aura apane hAtha ko sameMTa kara apane bag2ala meM to kara lo (phira dekho ki) vaha bag2aira kisI bImArI ke sapheda camakatA damakatA huA nikalegA ye dUsarA maujiz2A hai
(ye) tAki hama tumako apanI (kudarata kI) bar3I-bar3I nizAniyA~ dikhAe~
aba tuma phiraauna ke pAsa jAo usane bahuta sara uThAyA hai
mUsA ne arz2a kI paravaradigAra (maiM jAtA to hU~)
magara tU mere lie mere sIne ko kuzAdA pharamA
aura dilera banA aura merA kAma mere lie AsAna kara de aura merI z2abAna se luqanata kI giraha khola de
tAki loga merI bAta acchI taraha samajheM aura
mere kInevAloM meM se mere bhAI hArUna
ko merA vaz2Ira bojha baTAne vAlA banA de
usake z2arie se merI puzta maz2abUta kara de
aura mere kAma meM usako merA zarIka banA
tAki hama donoM (milakara) kasarata se terI tasabIha kareM
aura kasarata se terI yAda kareM
tU to hamArI hAlata dekha hI rahA hai
faramAyA ai mUsA tumhArI saba darakhvAsteM maMz2Ura kI gaI
aura hama to tuma para eka bAra aura ehasAna kara cuke haiM
jaba hamane tumhArI mA~ ko ilahAma kiyA jo aba tumheM ''vahI'' ke z2arie se batAyA jAtA hai

ki tuma ise (mUsA ko) sandUqa meM rakhakara sandUqa ko dariyA meM DAla do phira dariyA use Dhakela kara kinAre DAla degA ki mUsA ko merA duzamana aura mUsA kA duzamana (phiraauna) uThA legA aura maiMne tuma para apanI mohabbata ko DAla diyA jo dekhatA (pyAra karatA) tAki tuma merI qhAsa nigarAnI meM pAle pose jAo

(usa vakta) z2aba tumhArI bahana calI (aura phira unake ghara meM Akara) kahane lagI ki kaho to maiM tumheM aisI dAyA batAU~ ki jo ise acchI taraha pAle to (isa tadabIra se) hamane phira tumako tumhArI mA~ ke pAsa pahu~cA diyA tAki usakI ऑMkheM ThanDI raheM aura tumhArI (judAI para) kuढ़e nahIM aura tumane eka zakhsa (qibatI) ko mAra DAlA thA aura sakhta parezAna the to hamane tumako (isa) g2ama se najAta dI aura hamane tumhArA acchI taraha imtihAna kara liyA phira tuma kaI barasa taka madayana ke logoM meM jAkara rahe ai mUsA phira tuma (umra ke) eka andAje para A gae nabUvata ke qAyala hue
aura maiMne tumako apanI risAlata ke vAste muntaqhiba kiyA
tuma apane bhAI samaita hamAre maujiz2e lekara jAo aura (dekho) merI yAda meM sustI na karanA
tuma donoM phiraauna ke pAsa jAo bezaka vaha bahuta sarakaza ho gayA hai
phira usase (jAkara) naramI se bAteM karo tAki vaha nasIhata mAna le yA Dara jAe
donoM ne arz2a kI ai hamAre pAlane vAle hama Darate haiM ki kahIM vaha hama para jyAdatI (na) kara baiThe yA jyAdA sarakazI kara le
faramAyA tuma Daro nahIM maiM tumhAre sAtha hU~ (saba kucha) sunatA aura dekhatA hU~

g2araz2a tuma donoM usake pAsa jAo aura kaho ki hama Apa ke paravaradigAra ke rasUla haiM to banI isarAila ko hamAre sAtha bheja dIjie aura unheM satAie nahIM hama Apake pAsa Apake paravaradigAra kA maujiz2A lekara Ae haiM aura jo rAhe rAsta kI pairavI kare usI ke lie salAmatI hai
hamAre pAsa khudA kI tarapha se ye ''vahI'' nAz2ila huIhai ki yaqInana az2Aba usI zakhsa para hai jo (khudA kI AyatoM ko) jhuThalAe
aura usake hukma se mu~ha mor3e (g2araz2a gae aura kahA) phiraauna ne pUchA ai mUsA Aqhira tuma donoM kA paravaradigAra kauna hai
mUsA ne kahA hamArA paravaradigAra vaha hai jisane hara cIz2a ko usake (munAsiba) sUrata atA pharamAI
phira usI ne z2indagI basara karane ke tarIqe batAe phiraauna ne pUchA bhalA agale logoM kA hAla (to batAo) ki kyA huA
mUsA ne kahA ina bAtoM kA ilma mere paravaradigAra ke pAsa eka kitAba (lauhe mahaphUz2a) meM (likhA huA) hai merA paravaradigAra na bahakatA hai na bhUlatA hai

vaha vahI hai jisane tumhAre (fAyade ke) vAste z2amIna ko bichaunA banAyA aura tumhAre lie usameM rAheM nikAlI aura usI ne AsamAna se pAnI barasAyA phira (khudA pharamAtA hai ki) hama hI ne usa pAnI ke z2arie se mukhtalifa qismoM kI ghAse nikAlI
(tAki) tuma khuda bhI khAo aura apane cArapAyoM ko bhI carAo kucha zaka nahIM ki isameM aklamandoM ke vAste (qudarate khudA kI) bahuta sI nizAniyA~ haiM
hamane isI z2amIna se tuma ko paidA kiyA aura (marane ke bAda) isameM lauTA kara lAe~ge aura usI se dUsarI bAra (qayAmata ke dina) tumako nikAla khar3A kareMge
aura maiMne phiraauna ko apanI sArI nizAniyA~ dikhA dI
isa para bhI usane sabako jhuThalA diyA aura na mAnA (aura) kahane lagA ai mUsA kyA tuma hamAre pAsa isalie Ae ho

ki hama ko hamAre mulka (misra se) apane jAdU ke z2ora se nikAla bAhara karo acchA to (raho) hama bhI tumhAre sAmane aisA jAdU peza karate haiM phira tuma apane aura hamAre daramiyAna eka vakta muqarrara karo ki na hama usake qhilApha kare aura na tuma aura muqAbalA eka sAfa khule maidAna meM ho
mUsA ne kahA tumhAre (muqAbale) kI mIyAda z2Inata (Ida) kA dina hai aura usa roz2a saba loga dina caढ़e jamA kie jA~e
usake bAda phiraauna (apanI jagaha) lauTa gayA phira apane calattara (jAdU ke sAmAna) jamA karane lagA

phira (muqAbale ko) A maujUda huA mUsA ne (firaauniyoM se) kahA tumhArA nAsa ho khudA para jhUThI-jhUThI iphterA paradAz2iyA~ na karo varanA vaha az2Aba (nAz2ila karake) isase tumhArA maTiyAmeTa kara chor3egA
aura (yAda rakho ki) jisane iphterA paradAz2iyA~ na kI vaha yakInana nAmurAda rahA usa para vaha loga apane kAma meM bAhama jhagar3ane aura saragoziyA~ karane lage

(Aqhira) vaha loga bola uThe ki ye donoM yaqInana jAdUgara haiM aura cAhate haiM ki apane jAdU (ke z2ora) se tuma logoM ko tumhAre mulka se nikAla bAhara kareM aura tumhAre acche qhAse maz2ahaba ko miTA chor3eM
to tuma bhI khUba apane calattara (jAdU vag2airaha) durUsta kara lo phira parA (safa) bA~dha ke (unake muqAbale meM) A par3o aura jo Aja Dara rahA ho vahI phAyaz2ulaharAma rahA
g2araz2a jAdUgaroM ne kahA (ai mUsA) yA to tuma hI (apane jAdU) pheMko aura yA ye ki pahale jo jAdU pheMke vaha hama hI hoM

mUsA ne kahA (maiM nahIM DAlU~gA) balki tuma hI pahale DAlo (g2araz2a unhoMne apane karataba dikhAe) to basa mUsA ko unake jAdU (ke z2ora se) aisA mAlUma huA ki unakI rassiyA~ aura unakI char3iyA~ daur3a rahI haiM
to mUsA ne apane dila meM kucha dahazata sI pAI
hamane kahA (mUsA) isa se Daro nahIM yaqInana tuma hI vara rahoge

aura tumhAre dAhine hAtha meM jo (lAThI) hai use DAla to do ki jo karataba una logoM ne kI hai use har3apa kara jAe kyoMki una logoM ne jo kucha karataba kI vaha eka jAdUgara kI karataba hai aura jAdUgara jahA~ jAe kAmayAba nahIM ho sakatA
(g2araja mUsA kI lATI ne) saba har3apa kara liyA (ye dekhate hI) vaha saba jAdUgara sajade meM gira par3e (aura kahane lage) ki hama mUsA aura hArUna ke paravaradigAra para ImAna le Ae

jAdUgara bole ki aise vAjee va rauzana maujiz2Ata jo hamAre sAmane Ae una para aura jisa (khudA) ne hamako paidA kiyA usa para to hama tumako kisI taraha tarajIha nahIM de sakate to jo tujhe karanA ho kara guz2ara to basa duniyA kI (isI z2arA) z2indagI para hukUmata kara sakatA hai

(aura kahA) hama to apane paravaradigAra para isalie ImAna lAe haiM tAki hamAre vAste sAre gunAha mAfa kara de aura (qhAsa kara) jisa para tUne hameM majabUra kiyA thA aura khudA hI sabase behatara hai

aura (usI ko) sabase jyAdA qayAma hai isameM zaka nahIM ki jo zakhsa mujarima hokara apane paravaradigAra ke sAmane hAz2ira hogA to usake lie yaqInana jahannuma (dharA huA) hai jisameM na to vaha mare hI gA aura na z2indA hI rahegA
(sisakatA rahegA) aura jo zakhsa usake sAmane ImAnadAra ho kara hAz2ira hogA aura usane acche-acche kAma bhI kie hoMge to aise hI loga haiM jinake lie bar3e-bar3e bulanda rUtabe haiM
vaha sadAbahAra bAg2Ata jinake nIce nahareM jArI haiM vaha loga usameM hamezA raheMge aura jo gunAha se pAka va pAkIz2A rahe usa kA yahI silA hai

aura hamane mUsA ke pAsa ''vahI'' bhejI ki mere bandoM (banI isarAila) ko (misra se) rAtoM rAta nikAla le jAo phira dariyA meM (lAThI mArakara) unake lie eka sUkhI rAha nikAlo aura tumako pIchA karane kA na koI khaufa rahegA na (DUbane kI) koI dahazata
g2araz2a phiraauna ne apane lazakara samaita unakA pIchA kiyA phira dariyA (ke pAnI kA relA) jaisA kucha una para chAyA gayA vaha chA gayA
aura phiraauna ne apanI qauma ko gumarAha (karake halAka) kara DAlA aura unakI hidAyata na kI
ai banI isarAila hamane tumako tumhAre duzmana (ke paMje) se chur3AyA aura tuma se (kohetUra) ke dAhine tarapha kA vAyadA kiyA aura hama hI ne tuma para mana va salavA nAz2ila kiyA

aura (faramAyA) ki hamane jo pAka va pAqIz2A roz2I tumheM de rakhI hai usameM se khAo (piyo) aura usameM (kisI qisma kI) zarArata na karo varanA tuma para merA az2Aba nAz2ila ho jAegA aura (yAda rakho ki) jisa para merA g2az2aba nAz2ila huA to vaha yaqInana gumarAha (halAka) huA
aura jo zakhsa taubA kare aura ImAna lAe aura acche kAma kare phira sAbita qadama rahe to hama usako z2arUra bakhzane vAle haiM
phira jaba mUsA sattara AdamiyoM ko lekara cale aura khuda baढ़ Ae to hamane kahA ki (ai mUsA tumane apanI qauma se Age calane meM kyoM jaldI kI)

kyA jina logoM ne ImAna kubUla kiyA aura acche-acche kAma kie unako hama (una logoM ke barAbara) kara deM jo rUe z2amIna meM phasAda phailAyA karate haiM yA hama parahez2agAroM ko misala badakAroM ke banA deM
(ai rasUla) kitAba (kurAna) jo hamane tumhAre pAsa nAz2ila kI hai (bar3I) barakata vAlI hai tAki loga isakI AyatoM meM g2aura kareM aura tAki akla vAle nasIhata hAsila kareM

to hamane havA ko unakA tAbee kara diyA ki jahA~ vaha pahu~canA cAhate the unake hukma ke mutAbiqa dhImI cAla calatI thI

aura (ai rasUla) hamAre (qhAsa) bande ayyUba ko yAda karo jaba unhoMne apane paravaragiAra se phariyAda kI ki mujhako zaitAna ne bahuta az2Iyata aura takalIpha pahu~cA rakhI hai
to hamane kahA ki apane pA~va se (z2amIna ko) ThukarA do aura cazmA nikAlA to hamane kahA (ai ayyUba) tumhAre nahAne aura pIne ke vAste ye ThanDA pAnI (hAz2ira) hai

ye eka nasIhata hai aura isameM zaka nahIM ki parahez2agAroM ke lie (Aqherata meM) yaqInI acchI ArAmagAha hai
(yAni) hamezA rahane ke (behizta ke) sadAbahAra bAg2Ata jinake daravAz2e unake lie (barAbara) khule hogeM
aura ye loga vahA~ takiye lagAe hue (caina se baiThe) hogeM vahA~ (khuddAme behizta se) kasarata se meve aura zarAba ma~gavAe~ge
aura unake pahalU meM nIcI naz2aroM vAlI (zaramIlI) kamasina bIviyA~ hogI
(mominoM) ye vaha cIz2a haiM jinakA hisAba ke dina (qayAmata) ke lie tumase vAyadA kiyA jAtA hai
bezaka ye hamArI (dI huI) roz2I hai jo kabhI tamAma na hogI
ye parahez2agAroM kA (anjAma) hai aura sarakazoM kA to yaqInI burA ThikAnA hai
jahannuma jisameM unako jAnA par3egA to vaha kyA burA ThikAnA hai
ye khaulatA huA pAnI aura pIpa aura isa taraha anavA aqasAma kI dUsarI cIz2e haiM

ye (tumhArI celoM kI) phauja bhI tumhAre sAtha hI DhU~sI jAegI unakA bhalA na ho ye saba bhI doz2aqha ko jAne vAle haiM

(ai rasUla) tuma kaha do ki maiM to basa (az2Abe khudA se) DarAne vAlA hU~ aura yakatA qahAra khudA ke sivA koI mAbUda qAbile parasatiza nahIM
sAre AsamAna aura z2amIna kA aura jo cIz2e una donoM ke daramiyAna haiM (sabakA) paravaradigAra g2Aliba bar3A bakhzane vAlA hai
(ai rasUla) tuma kaha do ki ye (qayAmata) eka bahuta bar3A vAqiyA hai

mere pAsa to basa vahI kI gayI hai ki maiM (khudA ke az2Aba se) sApha-sApha DarAne vAlA hU~
(vaha bahasa ye thI ki) jaba tumhAre paravaradigAra ne phariztoM se kahA ki maiM gIlI miTTI se eka AdamI banAne vAlA hU~
to jaba maiM usako durUsta kara lU~ aura isameM apanI (paidA) kI huI rUha phU~ka do to tuma saba ke saba usake sAmane sajade meM gira par3anA

ki maiM tujhase aura jo loga terI tAbedArI kareMge una saba se jahannuma ko z2arUra bharU~gA
(ai rasUla) tuma kaha do ki maiM to tumase na isa (tabalIg2e risAlata) kI maz2adUrI mA~gatA hU~ aura na maiM (jhUTha mUTha) banAvaTa karane vAlA hU~
ye (qurAna) to basa sAre jahA~na ke lie nasIhata hai
aura kucha dinoM bAda tumako isakI haqIkata mAlUma ho jAegI
(isa) kitAba (qurAna) kA nAz2ila karanA usa khudA kI bAragAha se hai jo (saba para) g2Aliba hikamata vAlA hai
(ai rasUla) hamane kitAba (kurAna) ko bilkula ThIka nAz2ila kiyA hai to tuma ibAdata ko usI ke lie nirA khurA karake khudA kI bandagI kiyA karo

AgAha raho ki ibAdata to qhAsa khudA hI ke lie hai aura jina logoM ne khudA ke sivA (auroM ko apanA) saraparasta banA rakhA hai aura kahate haiM ki hama to unakI parasatiza sirfa isalie karate haiM ki ye loga khudA kI bAragAha meM hamArA taqarraba baढ़A degeM isameM zaka nahIM ki jisa bAta meM ye loga jhagar3ate haiM (qayAmata ke dina) khudA unake daramiyAna isameM phaisalA kara degA bezaka khudA jhUThe nAzukre ko maMz2ile maqasUda taka nahIM pahu~cAyA karatA
agara khudA kisI ko (apanA) beTA banAnA cAhatA to apane maqhalUqAta meM se jise cAhatA muntakhiba kara letA (magara) vaha to usase pAka va pAkIz2A hai vaha to yakatA bar3A z2abaradasta allAha hai

usI ne sAre AsamAna aura z2amIna ko bajA (durUsta) paidA kiyA vahI rAta ko dina para Upara tale lapeTatA hai aura vahI dina ko rAta para taha ba taha lapeTatA hai aura usI ne AphatAba aura mahatAba ko apane basa meM kara liyA hai ki ye sabake saba apane (apane) muqararra vakta calate rahegeM AgAha raho ki vahI g2Aliba bar3A bakhzane vAlA hai

usI ne tuma sabako eka hI zakhsa se paidA kiyA phira usa (kI bAqI miTTI) se usakI bIbI (hauvvA) ko paidA kiyA aura usI ne tumhAre lie ATha qisma ke cArapAe paidA kie vahI tumako tumhArI mA~oM ke peTa meM eka qisma kI paidAiza ke bAda dUsarI qisma (nutphe jamA huA khUna lothar3A) kI paidAiza se tehare tehare aMdheroM (peTa) rahama aura jhillI meM paidA karatA hai vahI allAha tumhArA paravaradigAra hai usI kI bAdazAhI hai usake sivA mAbUda nahIM to tuma loga kahA~ phire jAte ho
