phira agara mu~ha phera leM to (ai rasUla) hamane tumako unakA nigehabAna banAkara nahIM bhejA tumhArA kAma to sirpha (ehakAma kA) pahu~cA denA hai aura jaba hama insAna ko apanI rahamata kA maz2A cakhAte haiM to vaha usase qhuza ho jAtA hai aura agara unako unhIM ke hAthoM kI pahalI karatUtoM kI badaulata koI takalIpha pahu~catI (saba ehasAna bhUla gae) bezaka insAna bar3A nAzukrA hai
sAre AsamAna va z2amIna kI hukUmata qhAsa qhudA hI kI hai jo cAhatA hai paidA karatA hai (aura) jise cAhatA hai (faqata) beTiyA~ detA hai aura jise cAhatA hai (mahaz2a) beTA atA karatA hai
yA unako beTe beTiyA~ (aulAda kI) donoM kismeM inAyata karatA hai aura jisako cAhatA hai bAMjha banA detA hai bezaka vaha bar3A vAkifakAra qAdira hai

aura kisI AdamI ke lie ye mumakina nahIM ki qhudA usase bAta kare magara vahI ke z2arie se (jaise) (dAUda) parade ke pIche se jaise (mUsA) yA koI fariztA bheja de (jaise mohammada) g2araz2a vaha apane ekhteyAra se jo cAhatA hai paig2Ama bheja detA hai bezaka vaha AlIzAna hikamata vAlA hai

aura isI taraha hamane apane hukma ko rUha (qurAna) tumhArI tarapha 'vahI' ke z2arie se bheje to tuma na kitAba hI ko jAnate the ki kyA hai aura na ImAna ko magara isa (qurAna) ko eka nUra banAyA hai ki isase hama apane bandoM meM se jisakI cAhate haiM hidAyata karate haiM aura isameM zaqa nahIM ki tuma (ai rasUla) sIdhA hI rAstA dikhAte ho
(yAni) usakA rAstA ki jo AsamAnoM meM hai aura jo kucha z2amIna meM hai (g2araz2a saba kucha) usI kA hai suna rakho saba kAma qhudA hI kI tarapha rUjU hoMge aura vahI phaisalA karegA
hA mIma
rauzana kitAba (qurAna) kI qasama
hamane isa kitAba ko arabI z2abAna kurAna z2arUra banAyA hai tAki tuma samajho
aura bezaka ye (qurAna) asalI kitAba (lauha mahaphUz2a) meM (bhI jo) mere pAsa hai likhI huI hai (aura) yaqInana bar3e rUtabe kI (aura) puraaz2a hikamata hai
bhalA isa vajaha se ki tuma jyAdatI karane vAle loga ho hama tumako nasIhata karane se mu~ha mor3eMge (haragiz2a nahIM)
aura hamane agale logoM ko bahuta se paig2ambara bheje the
aura koI paig2ambara unake pAsa aisA nahIM AyA jisase ina logoM ne ThaTThe nahIM kie ho
to unameM se jo jyAdA z2orAvara the to unako hamane halAka kara mArA aura (duniyA meM) agaloM ke afasAne jArI ho gae
aura (ai rasUla) agara tuma unase pUcho ki sAre AsamAna va z2amIna ko kisane paidA kiyA to vaha z2arUra kaha deMge ki unako bar3e vAqifakAra z2abaradasta (qhudA ne) paidA kiyA hai
jisane tuma logoM ke vAste z2amIna kA bichaunA banAyA aura (phira) usameM tumhAre nafe ke lie rAste banAe tAki tuma rAha mAlUma karo

aura jisane eka (munAsiba) andAje qe sAtha AsamAna se pAnI barasAyA phira hama hI ne usake (z2arie) se murdA (paratI) zahara ko z2indA (AbAda) kiyA usI taraha tuma bhI (qayAmata ke dina qabroM se) nikAle jAoge
aura jisane hara kisma kI cIz2e paidA kIM aura tumhAre lie kaztiyAM banAyIM aura cArapAe (paidA kie) jina para tuma savAra hote ho

tAki tuma usakI pITha para caढ़o aura jaba usa para (acchI taraha) sIdhe ho baiTho to apane paravaradigAra kA ehasAna mAnA karo aura kaho ki vaha (qhudA hara aiba se) pAka hai jisane isako hamArA tAbedAra banAyA hAlaॉki hama to aise (tAqatavara) na the ki usa para qAbU pAte
aura hamako to yaqInana apane paravaradigAra kI tarapha lauTa kara jAnA hai
aura una logoM ne usake bandoM meM se usake lie aulAda qarAra dI hai isameM zaqa nahIM ki insAna khullama khullA bar3A hI nAzakrA hai
kyA usane apanI maqhalUqAta meM se qhuda to beTiyA~ lI haiM aura tumako cunakara beTe die haiM

hAlaॉki jaba unameM kisI zaqhza ko usa cIz2a (beTI) kI qhuzaqhabarI dI jAtI hai jisakI misala usane qhudA ke lie bayAna kI hai to vaha (g2usse ke mAre) siyAha ho jAtA hai aura tAva peMca khAne lagatA hai
kyA vaha (aurata) jo z2evaroM meM pAlI posI jAe aura jhagar3e meM (acchI taraha) bAta taka na kara sakeM (qhudA kI beTI ho sakatI hai)
aura una logoM ne fariztoM ko ki vaha bhI qhudA ke bande haiM (qhudA kI) beTiyA~ banAyI haiM loga phariztoM kI paidAiza kyoM khar3e dekha rahe the abhI unakI zahAdata qalama banda kara lI jAtI hai

aura (qayAmata) meM unase bAz2apursa kI jAegI aura kahate haiM ki agara qhudA cAhatA to hama unakI parasatiza na karate unako usakI kucha qhabara hI nahIM ye loga to basa aTakala paccU bAteM kiyA karate haiM
yA hamane unako usase pahale koI kitAba dI thI ki ye loga use maz2abUta thAmeM hue haiM
balki ye loga to ye kahate haiM ki hamane apane bApa dAdAoM ko eka tarIke para pAyA aura hama unako qadama ba qadama ThIka rAste para cale jA raheM haiM

aura (ai rasUla) isI taraha hamane tumase pahale kisI bastI meM koI DarAne vAlA (paig2ambara) nahIM bhejA magara vahA~ ke qhuzahAla logoM ne yahI kahA ki hamane apane bApa dAdAoM ko eka tarIke para pAyA, aura hama yaqInI unake qadama ba qadama cale jA rahe haiM

(isa para) unake paig2ambara ne kahA bhI jisa tarIqe para tumane apane bApa dAdAoM ko pAyA agarace maiM tumhAre pAsa isase behatara rAhe rAsta para lAne vAlA dIna lekara AyA hU~ (to bhI na mAnoge) vaha bole (kucha ho magara) hama to usa dIna ko jo tuma dekara bheje gae ho mAnane vAle nahIM
to hamane unase badalA liyA (to z2arA) dekho to ki jhuThalAne vAloM kA kyA anjAma huA
(aura vaha vakhta yAda karo) jaba ibrAhIma ne apane (mu~ha bole) bApa (Az2ara) aura apanI qauma se kahA ki jina cIz2oM ko tuma loga pUjate ho maiM yaqInana usase bez2Ara hU~
magara usakI ibAdata karatA hU~, jisane mujhe paidA kiyA to vahI bahuta jalda merI hidAyata karegA
aura usI (ImAna) ko ibrAhIma ne apanI aulAda meM hamezA bAqI rahane vAlI bAta chor3a gae tAki vaha (qhudA kI tarapha rUjU) kareM
balki maiM unako aura unake bApa dAdAoM ko phAyadA pahu~cAtA rahA yahA~ taka ki unake pAsa (dIne) haqa aura sAfa sAfa bayAna karane vAlA rasUla A pahu~cA
aura jaba unake pAsa (dIna) haqa A gayA to kahane lage ye to jAdU hai aura hama to haragiz2a isake mAnane vAle nahIM
aura kahane lage ki ye qurAna ina do bastiyoM (makke tAepha) meM se kisI bar3e AdamI para kyoM nahIM nAz2ila kiyA gayA

ye loga tumhAre paravaradigAra kI rahamata ko (apane taura para) bA~Tate haiM hamane to inake daramiyAna unakI roz2I dunayAvI z2indagI meM bA~Ta hI dI hai aura eka ke dUsare para darje bulanda kie haiM tAki inameM kA eka dUsare se qhidamata le aura jo mAla (mataA) ye loga jamA karate phirate haiM qhudA kI rahamata (paig2ambara) isase kahIM behatara hai

aura agara ye bAta na hotI ki (Aqhira) saba loga eka hI tarIqe ke ho jAe~ge to hama unake lie jo qhudA se inkAra karate haiM unake gharoM kI chateM aura vahI sIढ़iyA~ jina para vaha caढ़te haiM (utarate haiM)
aura unake gharoM ke daravAz2e aura vaha takhta jina para takiye lagAte haiM cA~dI aura sone ke banA dete
ye saba sAz2o sAmAna, to basa duniyAvI z2indagI ke (canda roz2A) sAz2o sAmAna haiM (jo miTa jAe~ge) aura Aqherata (kA sAmAna) to tumhAre paravaradigAra ke yahaॉ qhAsa parahez2agAroM ke lie hai
aura jo zaqhza qhudA kI cAha se andhA banatA hai hama (goyA qhuda) usake vAste zaitAna muqarrara kara dete haiM to vahI usakA (hara dama kA) sAthI hai
aura vaha (zayAtIna) una logoM ko (qhudA kI) rAha se rokate rahate haiM bAvajUda isake vaha usI khyAla meM haiM ki vaha yaqInI rAhe rAsta para haiM
yahA~ taka ki jaba (qayAmata meM) hamAre pAsa AegA to (apane sAthI zaitAna se) kahegA kAza mujhameM aura tumameM pUraba pazcima kA fAsalA hotA g2araz2a (zaitAna bhI) kyA hI burA raphIqa hai
aura jaba tuma nApharamAniyA~ kara cuke to (zayAtIna ke sAtha) tumhArA az2Aba meM zarIka honA bhI Aja tumako (az2Aba kI kamI meM) koI phAyadA nahIM pahu~cA sakatA
to (ai rasUla) kyA tuma baharoM ko sunA sakate ho yA andhe ko aura usa zaqhza ko jo sarIhI gumarAhI meM par3A ho rAstA dikhA sakate ho (haragiz2a nahIM)
to agara hama tumako (duniyA se) le bhI jAe~ to bhI hamako unase badalA lenA z2arUrI hai
yA (tumhArI z2indagI hI meM) jisa az2Aba kA hamane unase vAyadA kiyA hai tumako dikhA deM to una para hara taraha qAbU rakhate haiM
to tumhAre pAsa jo vahI bhejI gayI hai tuma use maz2abUta pakar3e raho isameM zaqa nahIM ki tuma sIdhI rAha para ho
aura ye (qurAna) tumhAre lie aura tumhArI qauma ke lie nasIhata hai aura anaqarIba hI tuma logoM se isakI bAz2apursa kI jAegI
aura hamane tumase pahale apane jitane paig2ambara bheje haiM una saba se dariyAphta kara dekho kyA hamane qhudA ki sivA aura mAbUda banAeA the ki unakI ibAdata kI jAe

aura hama hI ne yaqInana mUsA ko apanI nizAniyA~ dekara phiraauna aura usake darabAriyoM ke pAsa (paig2ambara banAkara) bhejA thA to mUsA ne kahA ki maiM sAre jahaॉna ke pAlane vAle (qhudA) kA rasUla hU~
to jaba mUsA una logoM ke pAsa hamAre maujiz2e lekara Ae to vaha loga una maujiz2oM kI ha~sI ur3Ane lage
aura hama jo maujiz2A una ko dikhAte the vaha dUsare se baढ़ kara hotA thA aura Aqhira hamane unako az2Aba meM giraphtAra kiyA tAki ye loga bAz2a Ae~
aura (jaba) az2Aba meM giraphtAra hue to (mUsA se) kahane lage ai jAdUgara isa ehada ke mutAbiqa jo tumhAre paravaradigAra ne tumase kiyA hai hamAre vAste duA kara
(agara aba kI chUTe) to hama z2arUra Upara A jAe~ge phira jaba hamane unase az2Aba ko haTA diyA to vaha phaurana (apanA) ahada tor3a baiThe

aura phiraauna ne apane logoM meM pukAra kara kahA ai merI qauma kyA (ye) mulka misra hamArA nahIM aura (kyA) ye nahareM jo hamAre (zAhI mahala ke) nIce baha rahI haiM (hamArI nahIM) to kyA tumako itanA bhI nahIM sUjhatA
yA (sUjhatA hai ki) maiM isa zaqhza (mUsA) se jo eka z2alIla AdamI hai aura (hakale pana kI vajaha se) sAfa guphtagU bhI nahIM kara sakatA
kahIM bahuta behatara hU~ (agara ye behatara hai to isake lie sone ke kaMgana) (qhudA ke haॉ se) kyoM nahIM utAre gaye yA usake sAtha farizte jamA hokara Ate
g2araz2a phiraauna ne (bAteM banAkara) apanI qauma kI aqala mAra dI aura vaha loga usake tAbedAra bana gaye bezaka vaha loga badakAra the hI
g2araz2a jaba una logoM ne hamako jhujhaMlA diyA to hamane bhI unase badalA liyA to hamane una saba (ke saba) ko Dubo diyA
phira hamane unako gayA guz2arA aura pichaloM ke vAste ibarata banA diyA
aura(ai rasUla) jaba mariyama ke beTe (IsA) kI misAla bayAna kI gayI to usase tumhArI qauma ke loga khilakhilA kara haMsane lage
aura bola uThe ki bhalA hamAre mAbUda acche haiM yA vaha (IsA) una logoM ne jo IsA kI misAla tumase bayAna kI hai to sirpha jhagar3ane ko

aura agara hama cAhate to tuma hI logoM meM se (kisI ko) farizte banA dete jo tumhArI jagaha z2amIna meM rahate
aura vaha to yaqInana qayAmata kI eka rauzana dalIla hai tuma loga isameM haragiz2a yaqa na karo aura merI pairavI karo yahI sIdhA rAstA hai
aura (kahIM) zaitAna tuma logoM ko (isase) roka na de vahI yaqInana tumhArA khullama khullA duzmana hai

aura jaba IsA vAz2ee va rauzana maujiz2e lekara Aye to (logoM se) kahA maiM tumhAre pAsa dAnAI (kI kitAba) lekara AyA hU~ tAki bAz2a bAteM jina meM tuma loga ekhtelApha karate the tumako sApha-sApha batA dU~ to tuma loga qhudA se Daro aura merA kahA mAno
bezaka qhudA hI merA aura tumhAra paravaradigAra hai to usI kI ibAdata karo yahI sIdhA rAstA hai
to inameM se kaI phiraqe unase ekhtelApha karane lage to jina logoM ne z2ulma kiyA una para dardanAMka dina ke az2aba se afasosa hai
kyA ye loga basa qayAmata ke hI munz2ira baiThe haiM ki acAnaka hI una para A jAe aura una ko qhabara taka na ho
(dilI) dosta isa dina (bAhama) eka dUsare ke duzamana hogeM magara parahez2agAra ki vaha dosta hI rahegeM
aura qhudA unase kahegA ai mere bandoM Aja na to tumako koI qhaupha hai aura na tuma g2amag2Ina hoge
(yaha) vaha loga haiM jo hamArI AyatoM para ImAna lAe aura (hamAre) faramAbaradAra the
to tuma apanI bIviyoM samaita ejAz2a va ikarAma se behizta meM dAkhila ho jAo
una para sone kI eka riqAbiyoM aura pyAliyoM kA daura calegA aura vahA~ jisa cIz2a ko jI cAhe aura jisase ऑMkheM lajz2ata uThAeM (saba maujUda haiM) aura tuma usameM hamezA rahoge
aura ye jannata jisake tuma vArisa (hissedAra) kara diye gaye ho tumhArI qAraguz2AriyoM kA silA hai
vahA~ tumhAre vAste bahuta se meve haiM jinako tuma khAoge
(gunAhagAra kuphfAra) to yaqIkana jahannuma ke az2Aba meM hamezA rahegeM
jo unase kabhI nAg2A na kiyA jAegA aura vaha isI az2Aba meM nAummIda hokara raheMgeM
aura hamane una para koI z2ulma nahIM kiyA balki vaha loga qhuda apane Upara z2ulma kara rahe haiM
aura (jahannumI) pukAregeM ki ai mAlika (darog2A e jahannuma koI tarakIba karo) tumhArA paravaradigAra hameM mauta hI de de vaha javAba degA ki tumako isI hAla meM rahanA hai
(ai kuphfAra makkA) hama to tumhAre pAsa haqa lekara AyeM haiM tuma me se bahuta se haqa (bAta se ciढ़te) haiM
kyA una logoM ne koI bAta ThAna lI hai hamane bhI (kucha ThAna liyA hai)
kyA ye loga kucha samajhate haiM ki hama unake bheda aura unakI sarag2oziyoM ko nahIM sunate haॉ (z2arUra sunate haiM) aura hamAre farizte unake pAsa haiM aura unakI saba bAteM likhate jAte haiM
(ai rasUla) tuma kaha do ki agara qhudA kI koI aulAda hotI to maiM sabase pahale usakI ibAdata ko taiyAra hU~
ye loga jo kucha bayAna karate haiM sAre AsamAna va z2amIna kA mAlika arza kA mAlika (qhudA) usase pAka va pAqIz2A hai
to tuma unheM chor3a do ki par3e baka baka karate aura khelate rahate haiM yahA~ taka ki jisa dina kA unase vAyadA kiyA jAtA hai
unake sAmane A maujUda ho aura AsamAna meM bhI (usI kI ibAdata kI jAtI hai aura vahI z2amIna meM bhI mAbUda hai aura vahI vAkifakAra hikamata vAlA hai
aura vahI bahuta bAbarakata hai jisake lie sAre AsamAna va z2amIna aura donoM ke daramiyAna kI huqumata hai aura qayAmata kI qhabara bhI usI ko hai aura tuma loga usakI tarapha lauTAe jAoge
aura qhudA ke sivA jinakI ye loga ibAdata karateM haiM vaha to siphAriza kA bhI ekhteyAra nahIM raqhate magara (haॉ) jo loga samajha bUjha kara haqa bAta (tauhIda) kI gavAhI deM (to khaira)
